The opportunity:

Flexport is a platform for global trade in an industry that comprises 12% of the global GDP.  We are the first licensed freight forwarder and customs brokerage built around a modern tech stack.  We help the world's fastest-growing brands manage their international supply chains, providing a fully-managed service for moving products between any two places on the planet.

Exceptional software development is integral in allowing us to fulfill our mission of fixing the user experience in global trade. At Flexport you’ll develop products that are at the forefront of reshaping the entire logistics & supply chain industries. You’ll work alongside self-starters interested in solving real-world problems and streamlining the inefficiencies in the complex global trade industry. You’ll have the opportunity to reshape an industry by creating the new operating system for global trade.

Our engineers are top-notch software developers who love listening to the users, working as a team, and proactively taking the lead whenever necessary. The role involves learning the business of freight forwarding, modeling the work that people do to move freight, designing solutions to make it more efficient, and thinking innovatively to automate much of it. In this role, you will have an opportunity to own the design and development of key parts of our forwarding systems. You will have influence on subsystem design and help contribute to a team culture around practices that are critical to a quality product. 

About the team:

We have multiple teams in Shanghai and Shenzhen working on a suite of core products and services that enable Flexport operation to scale, including Forwarding Application, Client Application, Shipper Application, WMS, Consol Planning Tool, Document Platform (AI empowered), Email Platform, Compliance Platform, Work Assignment Engine, Exception Management, AI Copilot, Insight Builder (AI Data Analytics) and so on. 

In addition, we have a NAWS (Native AWS) team that develops infrastructure solutions for our products and services using the latest Infrastructure as Code (IaC) technology: CDKTF (Cloud Development Kit for Terraform). Our scope includes, but is not limited to, CI/CD, observability, DevX, data subsetting (TS3), IaC, template engines, and various open-source projects. Additionally, the team provides technical guidance to engineers across the organization.

We are looking for engineers who love learning, are passionate about collaborating, and desire to build solutions with a global impact.

You will:

  • Build highly available, secure, distributed systems in a microservice architecture.
  • Build cutting edge infrastructure solutions to help improve development experience across the company. And, work closely with other engineering teams to help them solve infrastructure related problems.
  • Design, develop, test and maintain systems that represent the real-world intricacies of logistics entities, such as shipper, client, cargo, document, carrier, container, email etc.
  • Collaborate with some of the best engineers in the industry to work on complex business and technical problems.
  • Work closely with business partners and product managers to distill complex business problems into elegant technical solutions.
  • Build and launch products rapidly and incrementally. We ship to production dozens of times per day.
  • Ensure our products maintain a high-quality bar. We believe in anticipating issues by obsessing over metrics and applying key learnings from post-mortems to all our services.
  • Geek out about shipping and logistics. (We do this often.)

You should have:

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience writing software, and a strong engineering background.
  • 2+ years of design and architecture knowledge as well as familiarity with object-oriented analysis and design patterns (OOA/OOD)
  • Knowledge of at least one programming language such as TypeScript, Ruby, C, C++, Java, or Kotlin
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.
  • A bias for action. When you see a problem, you solve it.
  • The ability to convey technical ideas in common terms to business partners, product managers, and engineers alike.
  • Experience building large scale, high-performance systems in a complex, multi-tiered, distributed environment
  • Understanding of performance tradeoffs, load balancing and operational issues
  • Knowledge of professional software engineering practices & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operations
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as CDKTF, Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or similar.
  • Having basic concepts in AWS services, including IAM, EC2, ECS, S3, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, and VPC, or equivalent services from other cloud providers.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and monitoring/observability tools.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and optimize distributed systems and cloud deployments.
  • Non-optional: an aptitude for learning quickly.

title: Senior Manager, Supply Chain Protection & Loss Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. Protecting Flexport's global operations and assets, enabling secure trade worldwide.

The opportunity:

Join Flexport's dynamic Compliance Program as the Senior Manager, Supply Chain Protection & Loss Intelligence. This critical role serves as the single point of accountability for both supply chain protection and loss prevention across Flexport's entire footprint — offices, fulfillment centers, and partner sites worldwide. The Manager will be responsible for protecting Flexport employees, visitors, assets, and facilities through the design and execution of security programs, while simultaneously driving a proactive loss prevention strategy across the Omni fulfillment network.

Day-to-day, this means managing a team of 50+ contracted security officers across multiple locations, overseeing electronic security infrastructure (CCTV, access control), conducting investigations, and managing the security ticketing system. Strategically, it means building the analytical foundation to identify loss trends and security gaps before they become incidents, authoring the policies and SOPs that standardize how Flexport protects its people and assets globally, and ensuring every new facility launches with security infrastructure and protocols in place from day one. 

You will partner closely with operations, facilities, and leadership to design, implement, and scale security programs for existing and future locations, ensuring our people, assets, and reputation are safeguarded as Flexport rapidly expands into new markets. This is a unique opportunity to build a unified security strategy, moving beyond reactive incident management to a data-driven, proactive approach.

You will:

  • Develop and maintain security and loss prevention metrics, KPIs, and dashboards to measure program effectiveness across all facilities and regions
  • Analyze incident data to identify trends, loss patterns, root causes, and emerging risks — translating findings into actionable recommendations for leadership
  • Build reporting frameworks that support data-driven resource allocation, vendor performance evaluation, and security investment decisions
  • Provide regular analytical reports to senior management on security posture, loss prevention outcomes, and program ROI
  • Author, maintain, and enforce global security and loss prevention policies, ensuring consistency across all Flexport locations and compliance with local regulatory requirements in each jurisdiction
  • Develop and implement SOPs for key security scenarios (Active Shooter, Emergency Response, High Value Cage procedures, Product Disposal, etc.)
  • Create site-level security plans for new and existing facilities, tailored to local risk profiles and operational requirements
  • Design and deliver training programs across physical security and loss prevention topics (emergency response, office security, travel security, incident reporting, etc.)
  • Develop audit frameworks and LP checklists for site leads to execute on a recurring basis
  • Manage physical security programs across all Flexport facilities globally (offices, warehouses, and partner sites), including new locations as Flexport and the Omni fulfillment network expand into new markets
  • Lead security planning and infrastructure stand-up for new facilities and market entries, including site assessments, vendor selection, and system deployment
  • Administer and maintain electronic security systems, including CCTV surveillance and access control platforms, and evaluate new technology deployments
  • Serve as the crisis management coordinator, providing real-time threat assessments and coordinating emergency response across regions
  • Coordinate with HSE, HR, Legal, and Compliance on cross-functional security and safety matters
  • Drive loss prevention strategy and investigations for the Omni fulfillment network, including cargo theft, employee theft, unauthorized sellers, workplace violence, and empty package findings
  • Manage the security and loss prevention ticketing syste, including triaging, updating, and resolving tickets with accurate documentation
  • Identify root causes of supply chain losses and develop recommendations to reduce future risk
  • Review, collect, and preserve CCTV evidence to support investigations and legal proceedings
  • Manage third-party guard services across all locations, including oversight of 50+ security officers, performance tracking, and operational discipline
  • Manage relationships with security integrators and onboard new vendors as required for geographic expansion
  • Oversee vendor contracts, MSAs, and NDAs for all security-related service providers
  • Conduct regular business reviews with key vendors and evaluate service delivery against contractual obligations

You should have:

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in a rike that combined physical security or loss prevention responsibilities with data analytics, policy development, or program design. Traditional security experience alone is not sufficient — this role requires a candidate who has built metrics programs, authored policies, or used data to drive security strategy.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage security operations across multiple locations and geographies, including hands-on experience with electronic security systems (CCTV, access control platforms).
  • Demonstrated experience building and analyzing security and loss prevention metrics, with comfort working in data platforms and translating incident data into actionable insights and executive-level reporting
  • Proven ability to author global policies, SOPs, security plans, and program documentation from scratch.
  • Experience managing third-party guard services and security vendor contracts, as well as conducting complex investigations (theft, workplace violence, supply chain security).
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams including HR, Legal, Operations, and Compliance
  • An analytical mindset with attention to detail and the ability to identify root causes and solve problems
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed

You will get:

  • The opportunity to build and scale global security and loss prevention programs from the ground up in a rapidly expanding, tech-forward logistics company.
  • Direct impact on protecting Flexport's people, assets, and reputation across a vast international footprint.
  • A collaborative and innovative environment where your data-driven insights will directly inform strategic decisions.
  • Exposure to diverse global operations and the chance to work cross-functionally with teams like HSE, HR, Legal, and Trade Compliance.
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and the chance to join a company transforming global trade.

This is a high-visibility individual contributor role—you won't be managing people, you'll be doing the work that directly shapes our network design, carrier strategy, and cost structure.  In this role, you will not just build models, but proactively identify high-impact cost-saving and optimization opportunities, transforming raw analysis into business-critical strategy.Your analysis will inform senior leadership decisions on carrier RFPs, zone skip expansion, FC location strategy, and how we price and position our fulfillment product against competitors. You'll partner closely with carrier ops managers, supply chain leadership, data science, and commercial teams to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

You Will

  • Own lane analysis and zone skip strategy including lane-level margin modeling, utilization thresholds, go/no-go decision frameworks for trailer dispatch, and identification of new lane opportunities across our middle mile and deep injection network.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Execution: Translate complex operational and network simulations into structured project plans; partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to scale standalone analytical tools into platform-native features.
  • Build cost models and simulations that forecast the financial and service impact of network changes before they go live—new zone skip lanes, carrier mix shifts, rate card scenarios, schedule changes, and FC expansion. Your models will be the analytical foundation for major capital and operational decisions.
  • Conduct shipment and transportation cost analysis including label cost trends, carrier overpayment identification, rate shopping effectiveness, and per-shipment margin by merchant, lane, and carrier—surfacing where cost is leaking and quantifying the opportunity to recover it.
  • Support carrier RFP and network strategy by modeling rate card scenarios, benchmarking carrier economics across lanes and geographies, and building the analytical case for carrier mix decisions and contract negotiations.
  • Conduct supply chain analysis including inbound flow modeling, FC throughput and capacity analysis, and demand-driven network planning inputs to support inventory positioning and FC capacity planning.
  • Support network and location analysis to evaluate fulfillment center and sort center placement, injection point optimization, and the cost impact of serving different geographies from different nodes—helping us understand where to route volume to minimize transportation cost while maintaining service commitments.
  • Build reporting and business intelligence for carrier ops managers and transportation leadership—translating complex operational data into clear dashboards covering OTD, TNT performance, trailer utilization, and lane-level economics.
  • Drive cross-functional transportation initiatives as a project lead: defining scope, aligning stakeholders across carrier ops, engineering, finance, and commercial teams, and managing workstreams from analysis through implementation.
  • Produce competitive and strategic analysis on how Flexport's transportation network and product compare to the market—including how peers productize services like zone skipping—and build the analytical case for strategic shifts in our commercial offering.
  • Team Mentorship: Act as a technical and domain mentor, helping scale team capabilities in SQL best practices, data modeling frameworks, AI usage and effective stakeholder communication.

You Should Have

  • 3–6 years of experience in supply chain analytics, transportation strategy, network design, or a closely related analytical role.
  • Strong quantitative skills—you're comfortable building financial models, running scenario analysis, and designing simulations that inform network or operational decisions.
  • Proficiency in SQL; experience querying large operational datasets in tools like Snowflake, Redshift, or BigQuery.
  • Advanced Data Visualization: Strong proficiency with BI and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, PowerBI) to build automated, executive-ready dashboards. Experience with Python or R for predictive modeling is a plus.
  • Experience with transportation or supply chain economics: shipping cost structures, carrier rate cards, zone-based pricing, network cost modeling, or equivalent.
  • Supply chain or network economics—you have a solid understanding of freight procurement frameworks, carrier bid structures, or data-driven RFP evaluation models.
  • A track record of translating complex, multi-source data into clear recommendations that leadership actually acts on.
  • Strong project management instincts—you can own an analytical initiative end-to-end, drive cross-functional alignment, and deliver without needing close direction.
  • Excellent communication skills; you can present nuanced quantitative analysis simply and confidently to senior operational and commercial audiences.
  • Experience working in highly ambiguous operational environments—you're comfortable navigating fragmented or incomplete datasets and confidently making data-driven recommendations.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with zone skip, middle mile, parcel carrier networks, or last mile logistics.
  • Familiarity with rate shopping logic, fulfillment network simulation, or carrier rate card structures.
  • Python or R skills for advanced modeling, automation, or data pipeline work.
  • Background at a 3PL, e-commerce fulfillment company, carrier, or supply chain consulting firm.
  • Experience with BI tools such as Metabase, Looker, or Tableau for operational reporting.
  • Exposure to location optimization or facility network modeling.

descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The opportunity:

We’re looking for a highly capable Account Manager to join the Demand team and support the growth of Flexport in the region. 

Our account management team focuses on closing renewal, upsell and cross-sell opportunities from existing accounts. As an Account Manager, you will own the customer experience from start to finish. You will help the customers grow and realize the Flexport value proposition by deeply understanding the client’s supply chain and partnering to find solutions for them.

This role is ideal for someone with experience in account management and/or sales, and interested in supply chain and logistics. They will engage with customers with the objective of driving customer satisfaction. 

This role is ideal for a highly organized individual, with negotiation experience, excellent communication skills, and the ability to meet and exceed revenue and volume KPIs. It’s an exciting opportunity to contribute to company growth and deliver on our mission to make global trade easy for everyone.

You will:

  • Cultivate and grow relationships with key business stakeholders that empower the client and deepen the relationship with Flexport.
  • Meet regularly with clients to monitor the account health and find ways to improve on their current experience.
  • Use your knowledge of the client to identify, develop, and close upsell, cross sell and renewal opportunities.
  • Keep a close pulse on client financial health, reporting on the client’s financials and ensuring clients maintain consistent payment schedules.
  • Lead and actively participate in client onboarding and creating standard operating procedures.
  • Scope and guide the implementation stages and timelines for new opportunities and clients. 
  • Monitor client metrics data, working with Global Operations teams to ensure metrics consistently meet client expectations, address escalations and solve clients issues effectively and efficiently.
  • Use your deep/expert knowledge of the client’s business to lead the preparation and presentation of quarterly strategy reviews with minimal guidance.
  • Drive product adoption with client stakeholders to ensure that clients realize the full value with Flexport.
  • Regularly review and document the client’s success criteria. As the client’s needs evolve, you will refine the client’s success criteria.
  • Continue to expand your knowledge of supply chain processes though internal and external training offerings to best enable you to act as a trusted advisor.
  • You will use and maintain data to monitor the health of your respective book of business such as in SalesForce so that you can identify ways to improve the client’s Flexport experience

Prerequisites:

  • 2-4 years of experience in a sales/account management or a client facing role.
  • A background in logistics, freight forwarding, or supply chain is preferred.
  • Client-centric: obsessed with client outcomes, doing what it takes to deliver the client’s expectations, understanding your client’s current and future business goals and challenges and translating those into relevant solutions and strategic account planning.
  • Hands-on, process-oriented, structured thinking with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Deeply curious: always working to understand the client’s needs and learn how Flexport can best meet them.
  • Next-level attention to detail: enjoy combing through the metrics and details to identify opportunities to improve internally or better manage the client relationship.
  • Strong business acumen.
  • Proven track record of (cross)selling a product.
  • Strong focus on growing your customers through a consultative approach.

What's in there for you: 

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment 
  • Lunches: Claim back up to GBP 15 per day for lunch allowance on office days
  • 25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment, in addition to the usual bank holidays in England and Wales.
  • Health insurance: Flexport offers employees in UK private medical insurance including a dental care
  • Group Life Insurance 
  • Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.
  • Pension plan: Flexport offers employees in the UK a workplace pension plan 
  • Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members
  • Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.

Flexport's Global Operations team is the front line team responsible for successfully managing our Customer’s supply chains end to end. To achieve this the Global Operations Team is at the heart of delighting our customers, managing our partners and working closely with our technology partners to drive innovation through process automation. With our focus on developing a global network, our operational teams are strategically located across the world to manage and execute our services and products offered to our customers and partners. Flexport Global Operations raises the bar by using data to manage our customer’s supply chains and identifies opportunities to improve fidelity in planning, responsiveness and overall execution.

The Operations Associate is responsible for the ownership and execution of the end-to-end movement of global shipments within a regional network including Ocean less than and full container load (LCL and FCL), Ocean imports, Air imports and exports, and Cross-border trucking. This role will focus on driving a first in class customer experience by obsessing over quality and on time performance.

As a new team member in our Mexico Operations group, you'll begin by immersing yourself in our company culture and mastering world-class operations. As Flexport continues to grow, there could be opportunities for future Flexporters to become founding team members in new markets, relocate internationally, and help us expand our presence around the world. If you're interested in a fast-paced career with the potential for international experience, this opportunity could offer you unmatched growth and adventure.

You will: 

  • You will be the “front line” to ensure the highest standard of Flexport quality: shipments move on-time and exceptions are handled appropriately.
  • You will be responsible for ensuring your work satisfies internal KPIs and SLAs that demonstrate quality delivery.
  • You will follow standard operating procedures (SOP) 
  • You will own the client experience; solving client issues quickly and ensuring smooth operations at origin and destination, escalating issues as needed.
  • Your team will:
    • Seamlessly coordinate day-to-day logistics operations with internal and external partners such as steamship lines, air carriers, intermodal and drayage vendors, customs, trade lane management, warehousing, transloading, trucking, and the air operations team.
    • Execute the end-to-end movement of freight shipments within a regional network (both imports and exports), including intermodal movements.
  • You will assist the shipments managed by partners as we drive partner autonomy.
  • You will quote and invoice client shipments with responsibility to their P&L
  • Participate in QBR and MBR presentation prep as well as hold client operational calls when deemed necessary

You should have:

  • 2+ years of experience in logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain, ocean carrier operations, or consulting (ocean freight knowledge is a plus)
  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred
  • Able to adapt to new technology and can thrive in a fast paced environment
  • Effective time management. Be able to properly prioritize and manage a large volume of tasks
  • Attention to detail
  • Ability to effectively seek and receive feedback
  • Effective communication both verbally and in writing in client facing interactions
  • Teamwork and relationship building
  • Orientation towards working smarter and adopting best practices and standardization
  • Problem-solving capabilities
  • Fluent in English and Spanish
  • A "compliance first" attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.

The Opportunity

You will be a key partner to our General Managers and North America leadership across the Sales and Operations organizations. This is a role with both a strategic and a tactical edge: you’ll drive forecasting, planning, closing the books, and own the day-to-day tasks that keep the business moving. You’ll also play a key role in our AI transformation, working cross-functionally, with our accounting and data analytics teams to design and automate workflows across the enterprise.

If you want to work at the cross section of global trade, technology and modern finance you belong here.

You Will:

  • Partner with Sales & Operations Leadership: Serve as the strategic finance partner to GMs and NA leadership, monitoring trends, communicating performance, and empowering operators to manage their business with clarity and confidence.
  • Drive Business Outcomes Cross-Functionally: Operate at the intersection of strategy and execution. Translate commercial and operational questions into analysis that drives decisions, and work across teams to unblock bottlenecks and prioritize opportunities by impact.
  • Improve & Automate: Lead process improvements beyond your core reporting. Leverage cutting-edge AI tools to scale complex financial workflows and build tooling that supercharges the whole team.
  • Own the Reporting Cadence: Facilitate the monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting rhythm. Partner with Accounting to support the close, and make sure leadership has timely, accurate, and actionable numbers on a predictable schedule.
  • Partner with Data Analytics on KPIs: Work hand in hand with our Data Analytics team, who own dashboard design and maintenance, to define and maintain the key business KPIs that Sales and Operations leaders rely on to run their business.
  • Forecast, Plan & Analyze: Support forecasting, business planning, compensation planning, and budget-vs-actuals analysis for the Sales and Operations org. Develop a deep understanding of the key business drivers and surface the insights that matter.
  • Be a Source of Truth: Be the reliable source of truth for both the numbers and the status of key initiatives, holding cross-functional partners accountable for deliverables.

You Should Have:

Hard Skills

  • 3-5 years of experience in FP&A, Business Operations, or Data Analytics. Logistics or high-growth tech experience is a plus.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field. (required)
  • Financial Modeling: Strong financial modeling and Excel/GSheets skills (required).
  • Technical Skillset: Demonstrated competency with relational databases (Snowflake, SQL) and agentic coding platforms (Claude Code/Codex). Working knowledge of large language models and emerging interoperability standards such as Model Context Protocol. Experience with the Linux command line and version control (Git/GitHub) is highly preferred. 

Soft Skills

  • Self-Starter: A growth mindset and high emotional intelligence.
  • Curious & Resourceful: Innately curious and resourceful, with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: Ready to roll up your sleeves and solve ambiguous problems with little direction.
  • Communication: A proactive, persuasive communicator, both written and verbal, who can operate across multiple levels of the organization.
  • Critical & Strategic Thinking: Sound business judgment paired with strong critical and strategic thinking.
  • Time Management: Excellent time management, with a sense of urgency and the flexibility to move between strategic and tactical work.
  • Collaboration: A team player who makes cross-functional partners better.

Worried About Not Having Logistics Experience? Don’t be. We bring people from diverse backgrounds together with industry veterans to move the logistics industry forward, and we invest in your ramp from day one through Flexport Academy.

Why Flexport:

You’ll join a team operating with the agility of a startup and the data advantage of a global logistics leader. This is a hands-on environment for builders, not observers. You won’t just report on the business, you’ll help shape how Sales and Operations make decisions. You’ll own real analysis every day and partner directly with the leaders running North America. If that’s the kind of impact you’re after, let’s talk.

The Opportunity:

The Operations Associate role, based in Melbourne, is a rare opportunity to be at the ground floor of Flexport Australia’s growth. As one of our earliest team members in the region, you will wear many hats and play a defining role in shaping our operations, culture, and client experience. This is a career-defining role with a clear path forward. 

You will develop a deep understanding of global logistics end-to-end, from operations and process design to client management and commercial strategy, working alongside country leadership, operations management, and sales teams. This breadth of exposure is intentional: we want to develop the next generation of logistics leaders.

What You Will Do:

The role is anchored in operations, with a strong bent towards process improvement and automation. 

Core tasks:

  • Execute end-to-end shipments across all modes (FCL, LCL, Air, import and export), including bookings, documentation, and milestone tracking.
  • Communicate directly with clients, carriers, trucking providers, CFS/warehouse operators and customs teams to keep shipments on time and on spec.
  • Troubleshoot shipment exceptions proactively and escalate issues with clear context and a recommended path forward.
  • Maintain data accuracy across Flexport systems to meet KPIs and client SLAs.
  • Support account managers and customs teams to deliver an exceptional client experience.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify operational bottlenecks and design scalable solutions anchored in AI, code, and automation.
  • Build or contribute to internal tools, dashboards, and workflows that reduce manual effort and improve data quality.
  • Leverage AI tools proactively in your daily work—from drafting client communications to analysing shipment data—and share learnings with the team.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement; if you see something broken, fix it.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work directly with country management, operations leads, and sales teams to align on priorities and client needs.
  • Build trusted relationships with clients, external partners including carriers, customs brokers, and freight vendors.
  • Contribute to regional strategy discussions and bring an operator’s perspective to commercial decisions.

What we’re looking for

The four A’s

  • Agency: You don’t wait to be told. You identify problems, take ownership, and drive solutions without prompting. You treat Flexport’s business like your own.
  • Adaptability: You thrive in ambiguity and change your approach when circumstances demand it. You stay calm when things go sideways and help others do the same.
  • AI & Data Fluency: You are comfortable using AI tools and working with data. You ask good questions of datasets, build basic automations, and continuously seek to do more with less.
  • Ability to make judgements in ambiguity: You can make sound, well-reasoned decisions with incomplete information. You know when to escalate and when to act.

What you will need:

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to generate data-driven insights that inform decisions and strategy
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organisational skills
  • Commercial acumen with the ability to identify win-win operational and business opportunities
  • Courage to challenge existing processes and drive meaningful change
  • Experience in freight forwarding, supply chain, or logistics operations welcome, but not a hard pre-requisite

Skills & Mindset:

  • Hands-on, process-oriented, structured thinking with strong problem-solving capabilities
  • Keen interest in technology adoption
  • Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it!
  • Excitement to manage relationships and create a best-in-class operational structure
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and organizational skills
  • Client service mindset - obsessed with client and employee happiness

What’s in it for you:

  • The chance to help build something from the ground up in a high-growth market.
  • Broad exposure to country leadership, operations management, and commercial teams from day one.
  • A genuine understanding of how global logistics works; end to end, across all modes and geographies.
  • A culture that rewards ownership, creativity, and a bias for action.
  • International expatriation opportunities for high performers who deliver great results.

Fast, accurate insights are integral in allowing us to fulfill our mission of fixing the user experience in global trade. You’ll work alongside self-starters interested in solving real-world problems and streamlining the inefficiencies in the complex global trade industry. You’ll have the opportunity to improve an industry by analyzing the new operating system for global trade.

descriptionHtml:

Please submit your CV in English!

The opportunity:

The role of the Operations Associate is a critical part of making Flexport’s mission to make global trade easy for everyone a reality. Flexport today connects almost 10,000 clients and suppliers across 109 countries. In this role, your direct customers are the partners within your region: our account management and customs teams, subcontractors, carriers, terminals and trucking providers. Your work directly supports Flexport’s end customers in achieving their logistics goals. Most importantly, you will play a pivotal role in building the next operational model at Flexport: allowing us to effectively scale to achieve our mission of making global trade easier for everyone.

This role is designed to facilitate the movement of shipments while discovering and driving efficiencies that build and improve operations as part of our Global team. You will be responsible for ensuring that all customer shipments are executed according to plan, on time and within budget. As the person who manages movement in your region with laser focus, you have the unique opportunity to help your regional account team spot opportunities to improve and grow our customers’ business. You will drive impact through surfacing new ideas to eliminate waste, improve customer experience or introducing innovative ways of managing a supply chain.

Responsibilities:

  • Be the “front line” in ensuring the highest standard of Flexport quality: shipments move on-time and exceptions are handled appropriately
  • Be responsible for ensuring your work satisfies internal KPIs and SLAs that demonstrate quality delivery
  • Follow standard operating procedures (SOP)
  • Solve client issues quickly and ensure smooth operations at origin and destination and escalate issues as needed
  • Acting in the best interest of the company by avoiding leakages and ensuring cost conscious behavior 
  • Seamlessly coordinate day-to-day logistics operations with internal and external partners such as steamship lines, air carriers, intermodal and drayage vendors, customs, trade lane management, warehousing, transloading, trucking, and the air operations team
  • Execute the end-to-end movement of freight shipments within a regional network (both imports and exports), including intermodal movements
  • Assist the shipments managed by partners as we drive partner autonomy (if applicable in a given region)

Prerequisites:

  • BA/BS Degree or completed professional training as forwarding agent
  • 3+ years of experience in freight forwarding, and direct Air export experience
  • Fluent in French and English (other European languages are a plus)
  • Able to adapt to new technology and can thrive in a fast paced environment
  • Effective time management, be able to properly prioritize and manage a large volume of tasks
  • Attention to detail
  • Ability to effectively seek and receive feedback
  • Effective communication both verbally and in writing
  • Teamwork and relationship building
  • Orientation towards working smarter and adopting best practices and standardization
  • Problem-solving capabilities
  • A “compliance first” attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry

What else: 

  • You will work in a beautiful office in the city center of Paris with modern office equipment and a first class connection to the public transport system of Paris.
  • You will work in a fast growing and changing environment with a high motivated team, which is always open to hear your ideas
  • We invest in your personal and professional development by offering you internal and external trainings
  • During regular team events you can have a lot of fun with your teammates and connect with them aside from your working day

What we offer: 

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment 
  • 25 working days working days of paid annual leave per complete year of service
  • The employee shall be affiliated to the French social security system (Sécurité sociale) and the mandatory supplementary pension schemes (retraite complémentaire AGIRC-ARRCO) in accordance with applicable law. Employer and employee contributions shall be calculated and deducted in accordance with statutory rates.
  • 50% reimbursement of the cost of the public transportation subscription(s) used for travel between your place of residence and the workplace. 
  • Employer's collective supplementary health insurance scheme (mutuelle d'entreprise) as required by law. Flexport shall contribute at least 50% of the premium for the base coverage.
  • Lunches compensation: EUR 12 for every day worked in the office
  • Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child. 
  • Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.

descriptionHtml:

We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The role

We're looking for a Social Media and Content Marketing Manager to own the channels where Flexport shows up every day. You'll run our social presence, keep the blog full of content people actually want to read, and produce a newsletter that logistics leaders look forward to opening. You'll write most of it yourself, polish the visuals in Canva, cut short videos for social, and build a network of voices, inside Flexport and out, who amplify our story.

This is a hands-on job for a strong writer who gets social, has an eye for design, and likes shipping work rather than just planning it.

You will

  • Own Flexport's owned social channels day to day across LinkedIn, Twitter/X, YouTube, Facebook, and Instagram: plan the calendar, write the posts, publish, engage, and report on what's working.
  • Write and edit blog content that turns complex supply chain topics into pieces people finish and share, from thought leadership to customer stories to product updates.
  • Produce our newsletter end to end, from picking the stories to writing the copy to hitting send.
  • Design social graphics and light marketing assets in Canva, staying true to Flexport's brand.
  • Edit short-form video for social, including cutting clips, adding captions, and packaging them for each platform.
  • Build our influencer network on both sides: coach internal experts and executives to post with confidence, and cultivate relationships with external creators and industry voices.
  • Track performance across channels and use what you learn to make the next post, article, and newsletter better.

You should have

  • 5+ years in social media, content marketing, or a closely related role.
  • Genuinely strong writing. You can take a dense logistics topic and make it clear, sharp, and worth reading.
  • Hands-on experience managing owned media channels, including LinkedIn, Twitter/X, YouTube, Facebook, and Instagram.
  • A working command of social best practices across those platforms, from what to post to when and why, and how each channel differs.
  • Basic design editing skills. You're comfortable building clean, on-brand graphics in Canva.
  • Basic video editing skills. You can cut and caption short clips for social without needing a full production team.
  • Comfort managing several channels and deadlines at once, with the ownership to keep them all moving.
  • Bonus: experience building creator or influencer programs, or working in B2B, logistics, or tech.

descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Help Win New Business

The Opportunity:

We are scaling our dedicated Data Center practice, and we are looking for the person who will lead it. This is a founding commercial role. You will start as a team of one, owning the full sales motion end-to-end, and you will build the team around you as the practice grows. You will define how Flexport goes to market with hyperscalers, hardware OEMs, and the broader ecosystem. You will set the playbook, win the first marquee accounts, and hire the people who scale what you build. Reporting directly to the Regional General Manager, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy and direct access to executive leadership.

This role features a 50/50 compensation model (Base + Uncapped bonus, with accelerators), with OTEs of $500k+, designed for strong leaders who take bets on themselves.

Why This Role Is Different:

The data center logistics market is not a standard freight problem. A single AI compute rack can cost more than $1 million and weigh up to 4,000 pounds. Racks contain Class 9 dangerous goods (lithium-ion batteries) and liquid cooling systems requiring specialized handling. Construction sequencing failures delayed 57% of data center projects in 2025, meaning late freight isn’t just expensive, it can stop an entire build.

Flexport has built the capabilities this market demands:

  • 98%+ air on-time performance for Fortune 500 data center customers, achieved through dedicated ground setups that pick up directly from the tarmac at major hubs.
  • White glove project management for complex deliveries—including Next Flight Out (NFO), 747-400F charter solutions for oversized equipment, and highly orchestrated last-mile delivery to active construction sites.
  • TAPA Level A, CTPAT, and Dangerous Goods certifications, with full CCTV warehouse coverage and shock, tilt, and temperature monitoring across all major hubs.
  • $900M+ saved in tariff exposure for customers over five years, with an AI-powered customs auditor that error-checks 100% of filings prior to submission—achieving a 0.2% error rate, roughly ten times better than the industry average.
  • A 24/7 digital control tower giving customers and their supply chain partners real-time visibility, milestone tracking, and proactive exception management.

You Will:

  • Own the full commercial motion for Flexport’s Data Center practice: from pipeline generation through close and expansion.
  • Build, inspire, and ultimately lead a high-performing sales team as the practice scales, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, and developing Account Executives.
  • Define and execute a go-to-market strategy targeting hyperscalers, co-location providers, OEM hardware manufacturers, and EPC contractors across North America.
  • Establish and drive specific, targeted revenue goals and quotas; monitor and manage key performance metrics to ensure consistent performance.
  • Partner closely with Flexport’s operations teams and product teams to design and deliver mission-critical solutions.
  • Represent Flexport externally as a subject-matter authority in data center logistics: at industry events, in RFP processes, and in senior customer conversations.
  • Take an entrepreneurial approach: you are building something new inside a company with global scale, and you will bring both the vision and the execution.

You Should Have:

  • 10+ years of overall professional experience, including direct experience selling complex, high-value logistics or supply chain solutions to Fortune 500 customers.
  • Deep familiarity with the data center, hyperscaler, co-location, or critical infrastructure ecosystem, either through direct sales, account management, or operational roles.
  • A demonstrated track record as a top-performing individual contributor and, ideally, early-stage team builder: you know what it takes to close, and you know how to build a team that closes.
  • The instincts and resilience to operate as a team of one while building toward scale.
  • Strong consultative selling skills, with the ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving procurement, operations, logistics, and executive leadership.
  • Excellent analytical and commercial judgment: you can build and manage a pipeline, forecast accurately, and make strategic tradeoffs.
  • Exceptional communication skills and the ability to earn trust at every level, from AE to C-suite.
  • A “compliance first” attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.

You Will Get:

  • A 50/50 compensation model (base + uncapped bonus and accelerators) built for closers who bet on themselves.
  • Equity grants and comprehensive benefits.
  • Founding-level autonomy and direct access to executive leadership.
  • The mandate to build and lead the team as the practice scales.

You'll write most of it yourself, polish the visuals in Canva, cut short videos for social, and build a network of voices, inside Flexport and out, who amplify our story.

You will

  • Design social graphics and light marketing assets in Canva, staying true to Flexport's brand.
  • Edit short-form video for social, including cutting clips, adding captions, and packaging them for each platform.
  • Build our influencer network on both sides: coach internal experts and executives to post with confidence, and cultivate relationships with external creators and industry voices.
  • Track performance across channels and use what you learn to make the next post, article, and newsletter better.

You should have

  • 5+ years in social media, content marketing, or a closely related role.
  • Genuinely strong writing. You can take a dense logistics topic and make it clear, sharp, and worth reading.
  • Hands-on experience managing owned media channels, including LinkedIn, Twitter/X, YouTube, Facebook, and Instagram.
  • A working command of social best practices across those platforms, from what to post to when and why, and how each channel differs.
  • Basic design editing skills. You're comfortable building clean, on-brand graphics in Canva.
  • Basic video editing skills. You can cut and caption short clips for social without needing a full production team.
  • Comfort managing several channels and deadlines at once, with the ownership to keep them all moving.
  • Bonus: experience building creator or influencer programs, or working in B2B, logistics, or tech.

At Flexport, we make global trade easier for everyone — and enterprise fulfillment is where that promise gets tested at scale. As an Operations Solutions Manager, you'll sit at the intersection of commercial growth and operational execution, partnering daily with Sales, Account Management, Ops, Implementation, Solutions Engineering, Product, Tech, and Pricing to scope fulfillment solutions for high-volume, operationally complex enterprise clients. You'll be the one turning a client's ambitious (and often messy) requirements into a warehouse process that actually works — designing pick/pack flows, slotting strategy, and WMS/ERP integrations, then staying in the room through implementation to make sure what was sold gets delivered. The work is inherently ambiguous: no two enterprise clients want the same thing, so you'll build reusable frameworks as you go rather than following an existing playbook. If you can translate a pallet layout into a client-ready proposal, you'll fit right in here.

You will:

  • Partner with Sales to scope fulfillment solutions for prospective enterprise clients, serving as the operational SME in client-facing conversations on capabilities and custom flows
  • Own solution design from pre-sale through onboarding, including time studies, equipment cost scoping, and total cost-to-serve estimates.
  • Design warehouse workflows and process flow diagrams (inbound, putaway, pick/pack, returns) for non-standard requirements — WMS/ERP configurations, storage methodology, slotting — with an explicit cost lens to flag workflows that break at scale.
  • Identify gaps in product capabilities and operational processes, and build the business case for tooling, process, or headcount investments.
  • Propose implementation timelines based on scope of work and technical/ops readiness.
  • Establish reusable frameworks and best practices for onboarding and solutioning enterprise accounts.

You should have:

  • 5+ years of hands-on warehouse operations experience with process/industrial engineering fundamentals, including slotting/cube optimization, facility layout design, capacity analysis, and space planning.
  • Experience building or validating cost-to-serve/pricing models, ideally from deal desk or pricing conversations.
  • Strong working knowledge of WMS and ERP platforms and how they integrate in a fulfillment environment.
  • Cross-functional experience with Sales, Account Management, Ops, Implementation, Solutions Engineering, Product, Tech, and Pricing in a solutions or pre-sales capacity, moving fluidly between operational detail and client-facing communication.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to translate operational constraints for commercial stakeholders.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, a bias toward building structure where none exists, and willingness to travel 50%.
  • A ""compliance first" attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry

descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. The Opportunity: 

Flexport IT is looking for a Senior Systems Engineer (Identity & Access). In this role, you will design, implement, and administer our Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions to ensure secure, efficient user lifecycle management.

While you are our resident Okta expert, you are also a high-level IT generalist. You will oversee our broader SaaS ecosystem (Google Workspace, Slack, Jira) and endpoint management infrastructure (Jamf, Intune). Your expertise will drive automation, protect sensitive data, mitigate security risks, and maintain compliance in a heavily regulated industry.

You will continually strive towards automation of toil. If you are still manually doing the same operational tasks 18 months from now, something has gone wrong. Flexport’s book of business is growing fast, but the promise of technology is that we can grow our business faster than our headcount. The automation you build will be a key factor in that effort.

You Will

  • IAM Architecture: Design, implement, and maintain the end-to-end lifecycle of Identity and Access Management platforms.
  • Okta & Directory Trust: Administer Okta, directory services, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and advanced password management.
  • SaaS Operations: Manage core collaboration tools including Google Workspace, Microsoft O365, Slack, and Jira/Confluence.
  • Unified Endpoint Management: Oversee our global fleet of Mac and Windows devices using Jamf and MS Intune.
  • Lifecycle Automation: Build automated workflows for provisioning, deprovisioning, and application access.
  • Identity Governance: Establish role-based access control (RBAC), entitlement reviews, and access certification processes.
  • SSO Integration: Lead the technical onboarding of new SaaS applications for Single Sign-On (SSO).
  • Security Partnership: Collaborate closely with the Security team to embed security best practices into our IT infrastructure.
  • Documentation & Roadmaps: Author technical operating procedures, engineering roadmaps, and compliance policies.
  • Operations Support: Provide high-tier technical leadership and escalation support for complex IT operations.

You Should Have

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in IAM systems engineering paired with broad IT infrastructure management.
  • Okta Expertise: Deep, hands-on mastery of Okta configuration, policy creation, and application integration.
  • Core Protocols: Strong knowledge of IAM standards including SAML, SCIM, OAuth, OIDC, IGA, RBAC, and LDAP.
  • Automation Skills: Experience with scripting (e.g., Python, Bash, or PowerShell) and Okta Workflows to automate IT tasks.
  • SaaS & Endpoint Ecosystem: Proven track record managing Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, Jamf (macOS), and Intune (Windows).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical engineering experience.
  • Compliance Mindset: A "compliance-first" attitude to navigate the rigorous requirements of a heavily regulated industry.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving abilities paired with strong collaborative and interpersonal communication.

You'll join our core Customs team—a product poised for more than 10x growth in the next five years—and play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. You'll be on the front lines, working with clients, shippers, and government agencies to clear goods across international borders. Forget old-school logistics; here, you'll use Flexport's state-of-the-art technology to automate processes and set new industry standards. The opportunity:

Flexport is a platform for global trade in an industry that comprises 12% of the global GDP.  We are the first licensed freight forwarder and customs brokerage built around a modern tech stack.  We help the world's fastest-growing brands manage their international supply chains, providing a fully-managed service for moving products between any two places on the planet.

Exceptional software development is integral in allowing us to fulfill our mission of fixing the user experience in global trade. At Flexport you’ll develop products that are at the forefront of reshaping the entire logistics & supply chain industries. You’ll work alongside self-starters interested in solving real-world problems and streamlining the inefficiencies in the complex global trade industry. You’ll have the opportunity to reshape an industry by creating the new operating system for global trade.

Our engineers are top-notch software developers who love listening to the users, working as a team, and proactively taking the lead whenever necessary. The role involves learning the business of freight forwarding, modeling the work that people do to move freight, designing solutions to make it more efficient, and thinking innovatively to automate much of it. As a full stack Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for architecting, designing, developing, testing and maintaining critical forwarding related systems. In addition, as the team lead, you are expected to mentor other engineers and lead them deliver high quality results that meet customer expectations. 

About the team:

We have multiple teams in Shanghai and Shenzhen working on a suite of core products and services that enable Flexport business to scale, including Freight Services Planning, Procurement, Commerce, Security and Infrastructure, Visibility and Schedules, and so on. We are broadly leveraging optimization models, machine learning (ML) and natural language processing (NLP) to build the best solutions for our customers. We are looking for engineers who love learning, are passionate about collaborating, and desire to build solutions with a global impact.

You will:

  • Build highly available, secure, distributed systems in a microservice architecture.
  • Design, develop, test and maintain systems that represent the real-world intricacies of logistics entities, such as shipper, client, cargo, document, carrier, container, email etc.
  • Collaborate with some of the best engineers in the industry to work on complex business and technical problems.

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer, Autonomous Supply Chains
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Senior Applied AI Engineer, Autonomous Supply Chains

About Flexport

Look around you. Almost everything in the room crossed an ocean to get there. Moving one container from a factory to a warehouse takes 10 to 15 companies: truckers, customs brokers, port terminals, ocean carriers, insurers, lenders and warehouses, each with its own systems, paperwork and rules. A freight forwarder runs that whole journey, so the brand that makes the goods doesn't have to.

Most forwarders still run it on email, spreadsheets and phone calls. We call it email freight forwarding. Flexport runs it on one platform, where AI agents do the routine work and experts step in where judgment matters. We've moved $175B of goods for more than 13,000 brands across 135 countries. Our agents handle 21 million tasks a year, and up to 80% of customs work is automated.

Global logistics is a $13 trillion industry, and even the largest forwarder earns less than 3% of global logistics outsourcing revenue. People-powered operations don't scale: to grow, you hire. Software broke that ceiling for taxis with Uber, and for payments with Adyen and Stripe. Freight is next.

Amsterdam is one of Flexport's six engineering hubs, alongside San Francisco, Seattle, Chicago, Shanghai and Shenzhen. We own four domains end to end: Customs Technology, Autonomous Supply Chains (Applied AI), Platform and Security. See what we build at amsterdam-engineering.flexport.com.

The team: Autonomous Supply Chains

Logistics is famously hard to automate, because the happy path rarely happens. One customer won't take deliveries on a Tuesday. Another wants invoices only on Fridays, with some lines merged and others renamed. Until recently, people handled all of that by hand. Now operators use Forge, the agentic platform we build, to automate their own work: catching anomalies, routing exceptions, escalating stuck containers and adjusting invoices to each customer. Forge remembers every customer's rules and learns from every workflow run, so it gets smarter every day.

Autonomous Supply Chains is our Applied AI team: small, senior and reporting to the VP of Engineering. Self-driving cars are rated from level 0 to level 5. Most of the freight industry still runs at level 0: people emailing spreadsheets. Our goal is level 5 for freight, with Forge as the best agentic platform there is, handling every complexity, every calamity and every odd preference without skipping a beat.

Stack: TypeScript, Rust, Next.js, Temporal, Postgres and Snowflake, with models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google.

The role

As a Senior Applied AI Engineer on Autonomous Supply Chains, you'll build the agents and AI-powered applications that make Flexport's operations faster and increasingly autonomous. You'll find the most painful problems in our operations, design the solution and ship it to operators moving freight across 135 countries. This isn't a role where you join a team and pick up tickets.

What you'll do

  • Design and ship end-to-end AI agents that handle real logistics work, such as customs compliance, document processing, invoice validation and exception management.
  • Build the evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop flows that make an agent trustworthy enough to run 24/7.
  • Stay on top of what's happening in the world of AI, and channel those innovations straight into the product. When Jev came out this fall, we had three use cases live within two weeks.
  • Work directly with operators, domain experts and leadership to turn ambiguous problems into shipped products, and measure whether they worked.
  • Move fast from idea to production, and treat every deployment as a chance to learn.
  • Cross organizational boundaries to understand problems deeply and get things done without waiting for permission.

You should have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, and you've built seriously with LLMs, whether in production, in side projects or just because you couldn't stop yourself.
  • LLM fluency: agent patterns, tool use, RAG, prompt design and evaluation. You know the difference between what works in production and what looks good in a demo.
  • Full-stack capability in TypeScript and Next.js. You can own a feature end to end.
  • Product instinct: you can tell what's worth building, not just how to build it.
  • Clear written and spoken communication in English, including design docs that people actually read.

Nice to have

  • Experience with workflow orchestration, such as Temporal.
  • Experience building internal tools or operator-facing applications.

How we work

  • We value builders. People who think end to end, do their own discovery and ship independently. Nobody hands you a spec.
  • Your users sit next to you. Operators, customs experts and account teams work in the same office. Watch them use your tool, and fix it before dessert.
  • Any model, any harness. Use any frontier model from Anthropic, OpenAI or Google, in all the popular coding harnesses. Our engineers manage swarms of coding agents from their first week.
  • We ship dozens of times a day, with continuous deployment and a platform team obsessed with making it safe and fast.
  • Hybrid, in English. We're together in our office on Nieuwezijds Voorburgwal, a few minutes from Dam Square, three days a week*. The other days are flexible. English is our working language, and we work daily with colleagues in the US and China.
  • No logistics background needed. Almost nobody joins knowing what an HTS code or a bill of lading is. The experts sit a few desks away.
  • Agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best.

Why this role is special

  • Your work is visible: a small, senior team that reports to the VP of Engineering. What you build gets noticed, and your ideas shape the direction.
  • Real stakes: your agents act on real shipments for 13,000+ brands in 135 countries, so the impact is immediate and measurable.
  • You're early: the playbook for applied AI in logistics hasn't been written yet. You'll help write it.

What's in it for you

  • Equity for everyone: every team member becomes a shareholder in a pre-IPO company in a multi-trillion dollar industry.
  • 25 vacation days, based on full-time employment, plus Dutch public holidays.
  • Health insurance, fully paid: a collective plan with basic and additional packages. Flexport pays the monthly premium.
  • Pension: a defined contribution scheme.
  • Breakfast and lunch: daily catered lunch with vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and drinks in the office.
  • Commute covered: Flexport covers home-to-office commuting costs if you live outside Amsterdam.
  • Parental leave: time off for both parents to bond with a new child.
  • Wellbeing support: an Employee Assistance Program through Aetna for you and your household, at no cost.
  • Visa sponsorship: we sponsor visas for the right candidates and help you move to Amsterdam. Eligible international hires may also benefit from the Dutch expat tax ruling.

Our hiring process

  1. Application review: our team reviews your application.
  2. Recruiter screen: talk about your experience, the role and your questions about Flexport.
  3. Remote coding: your first coding interview takes place over video.
  4. Onsite coding and system design: a second coding interview and system design in our office.
  5. Project deep dive: discuss a project from your experience with the hiring manager.
  6. Team debrief: the interview team reviews feedback together. You don't attend this step.
  7. Offer: if there's a match, your recruiter walks you through the offer.

An additional remote coding round may be needed if the earlier coding interviews leave questions to resolve. Your recruiter will confirm the plan before interviews begin. We only contact candidates from @flexport.com addresses, and we will never ask you for money or banking details.

About Flexport

Flexport’s mission is to make global trade so easy there will be more of it. We bring together logistics expertise, technology, and AI to help businesses manage global trade.

The Opportunity

Lead how money moves through Flexport’s Asia-Pacific (APAC) business. Based in Hong Kong, you’ll own regional accounts receivable (AR), accounts payable (AP), and freight audit, with responsibility for cash collection, payment accuracy, and the teams delivering those results.

You’ll shape how these functions operate as Flexport grows across the region. That means redesigning workflows around AI and agents, developing your team’s capabilities, and turning improvements into measurable business results. You’ll work with global finance leadership and regional partners to set priorities, resolve complex issues, and build processes that work across countries, currencies, and entities.

We’re looking for a finance leader who combines operational depth with curiosity and the ability to build. You’re comfortable challenging an established process, testing a better approach yourself, and leading a team through the change.

You Will

  • Own APAC performance across AR, AP, and freight audit. Set priorities and targets, review results with global finance leadership, and take action on collection risk, payment issues, and operational backlogs.
  • Improve cash collection and reduce overdue receivables. Lead collections strategy, cash application, and dispute resolution; partner with Credit, Billing, Sales, and Operations to address credit blocks and fix recurring causes of delayed payment.
  • Lead accurate, timely supplier and carrier payments. Oversee invoice validation, freight charge reviews, reconciliations, and payment exceptions, resolving discrepancies with vendors and operational teams before they become recurring problems.
  • Build, test, and deploy AI agents and automated workflows with Finance Systems and technical partners. Focus on practical uses such as prioritizing collections, coordinating follow-ups, reviewing invoices, matching payments, and identifying exceptions.
  • Own improvements from problem definition through adoption. Set a baseline, prioritize the highest-value opportunities, test workflows against real cases, and measure their effect on accuracy, processing time, and cash performance.
  • Lead and develop regional teams. Set clear expectations, coach performance, build future leaders, and help people use AI effectively while applying judgment to complex customer and vendor situations.
  • Maintain strong financial controls as workflows change. Define approval and exception handling, verify automated outputs, and protect data integrity. Partner with Accounting and Tax to meet local invoicing, tax, and statutory requirements.
  • Standardize processes across APAC while accounting for local requirements. Lead system testing and adoption, document operating practices, and give senior stakeholders clear recommendations on risks and investment priorities.

Success in Your First Year

  • Collections improve against agreed targets, with lower overdue balances and days sales outstanding (DSO), faster dispute resolution, and fewer unresolved cash application issues.
  • Supplier and carrier payments become more reliable, with better invoice accuracy, shorter processing times, and fewer aged exceptions.
  • Teams use AI agents and automation in daily operations, with measured reductions in manual work and controls that remain effective.
  • Regional teams have clear ownership, stronger capabilities, and consistent performance reporting that helps leadership act early.

You Should Have

  • 8+ years of experience in financial operations, accounts receivable, accounts payable, or a related finance function, including 3+ years leading and developing teams in a complex or global organization.
  • Deep expertise in AR or AP, with practical working knowledge across collections, payments, reconciliations, and financial controls. You can demonstrate measurable improvements in cash collection, payment performance, or operational accuracy.
  • Experience managing high-volume operations across multiple entities and currencies, including APAC markets. You understand how regional payment practices, invoicing rules, and tax requirements affect day-to-day execution.
  • Hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve finance work. You can explain a workflow you built or improved, how you checked its results, and what changed for the business.
  • Experience leading change across functions, from defining requirements and testing systems to training teams and sustaining adoption. You can influence senior stakeholders and handle difficult customer or vendor conversations.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, spreadsheets, and reporting tools. You can investigate underlying transactions, turn data into a clear recommendation, and defend the result.
  • A sound grounding in accounting, internal controls, and compliance, supported by a degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or an equivalent professional qualification.

Helpful, but Not Required

  • Experience in logistics, freight, supply chain, or freight audit; familiarity with carrier billing and payment flows.
  • A professional accounting designation, experience scaling shared services, or additional languages used across APAC.
