title: Senior Security Engineer, Detection & Response
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

What you'll do

There is no MSSP and no tier-1 queue here. Detection & Response engineers own their detections end to end: you write them, you tune them, and your team is paged when they fire. The security team is spread across the globe with a follow-the-sun pager rotation so nobody is paged at 3am local.

The adversaries are real. The business is growing fast and the threat surface is growing with it. Defining the necessary telemetry is part of the job.

Detection engineering

  • Build and tune detections across endpoint, identity, SaaS, and cloud, treating them as software: version-controlled, peer-reviewed, and shipped through the same CI/CD practices the rest of engineering uses.
  • Track detection quality as measured quantities: coverage against MITRE ATT&CK, precision, time-to-detect. We don’t build-and-forget here.

Response & automation

  • Own incident response: triage, contain, remediate, and write the retrospective that turns the incident into a systemic fix.
  • Build automation that removes toil from investigations, and partner closely with the US-based team so context carries across time zones instead of getting lost at handoff.

Telemetry & partnership

  • Define telemetry requirements for new systems before they ship, working with infrastructure and product teams to close visibility gaps rather than discovering them during an incident.
  • Threat hunt proactively across the estate, converting hypotheses into either new detections or documented coverage.

You Should Have

  • Typically 5–8 years of experience in detection engineering, incident response, or threat hunting, with real hands-on time writing and tuning detections. We care more about what you've built than the exact number.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, or similar) and comfort writing production-grade detection and automation code.
  • Experience with a modern SIEM or detection pipeline (Panther, Elastic, Splunk, or similar). What matters is that you've shipped and tuned detection logic in production.
  • Practical incident response experience: you've led or played a major role in triaging and closing out real security incidents.

Nice to have

  • Experience treating detections as code with CI/CD, peer review, and staged rollout.
  • Experience defining telemetry contracts for systems before they ship, rather than retrofitting logging after an incident.
  • A track record of critically evaluating and verifying AI-assisted work - testing, source-checking, validation - rather than trusting agent output by default. If you haven’t already spotted the em dashes in this job description and already thought about where the hiring manager (hi!) has put hands on keyboard and compared that to where they let the LLM watermarks through, you might not be the right person for the job.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native and Kubernetes telemetry.
  • Experience with fraud or financial-crime detection patterns.

How we work

  • We're in the San Francisco office regularly to work through incidents and detection design in person.
  • We stay closely aligned with teammates on other continents via Slack, video, and async docs.
  • We have the latest hardware and software, including frontier AI models on day one.
  • We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best.

Why this role is special

  • You own your detections end to end, no MSSP, no tier-1 queue, no handing your work to someone else to triage.
  • The consequences here are physical, not abstract: a containment decision can stop a customs filing or freight actually moving, which makes the stakes concrete in a way a SaaS control plane rarely is.
  • You'll inherit a real, established estate with legacy telemetry gaps to close, genuinely underexplored surface area, not a well-mined problem.

Where you'll work

This role is based in San Francisco, and we have a strong preference for candidates who are there or willing to relocate — we're deliberately building this team in one place. Relocation support is available for the right candidate.

Investing your time with Flexport means having immediate impact, all over the world. You're empowered to do what's best for everyone and trusted to make the right decisions when and where you need them. Join our collective of entrepreneurs and improve the world's experience in global trade.

Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

About the role: 

This role is based in Flexport’s new Dublin office and is one of the first Account Executive positions on the ground in Ireland. As part of the founding commercial team, you have the opportunity to build a completely new territory within Flexport — shaping the go-to-market approach, establishing the first enterprise relationships, and helping define how Flexport operates and wins in the Irish market from the ground up.

You will be responsible for driving complex, high-value enterprise deals and establishing long-term strategic partnerships with large customers. This role owns advanced, multi-stakeholder sales cycles that often span regions, business units, and decision layers.

You will be operating with a high degree of autonomy, shaping deal strategy, influencing executive stakeholders, and orchestrating cross-functional teams to deliver differentiated, value-driven solutions.

Pipeline & Opportunity Ownership

  • Own and close high-value, complex enterprise opportunities, consistently meeting or exceeding individual quotas.
  • Build a strategic pipeline through self-prospecting, account planning, and SDR partnership.
  • Proactively identify whitespace, expansion potential, and multi-entity opportunities within target accounts.
  • Maintain forecasting, opportunity hygiene, and deal governance in Salesforce (SFDC).

Strategic Discovery & Solution Architecture

  • Lead executive-level discovery to understand enterprise supply chain strategy, risk posture, and long-term business objectives.
  • Navigate complex buying groups across procurement, ops, finance, IT, and senior leadership.
  • Design integrated, multi-product Flexport solutions aligned to customer priorities and business outcomes.
  • Position Flexport as a strategic partner through compelling value narratives, business cases, and solution roadmaps.

Deal Strategy, Negotiation & Closing

  • Own end-to-end deal strategy for complex opportunities, including stakeholder mapping, decision criteria, and close plans.
  • Lead advanced commercial negotiation, pricing, contracts, and non-standard deal structures.
  • Orchestrate internal stakeholders (Ops, Finance, Legal, Product) to progress deals efficiently

Onboarding, Expansion & Relationship Leadership

  • Own the onboarding motion, ensuring enterprise customers are set up for scalable success.
  • Establish and maintain trusted relationships with senior and executive customer stakeholders.
  • Identify expansion opportunities together with Account Management to drive sustained growth.
  • Serve as a point of escalation and strategic advisor during the customer lifecycle.

Enterprise Leadership & Market Impact

  • Act as a senior commercial voice in enterprise pursuits, sharing market insight and customer feedback internally.
  • Contribute to enterprise sales best practices, deal reviews, and peer coaching.
  • Represent Flexport with credibility and confidence in high-stakes customer interactions.
  • As part of the founding Irish team, help shape early market strategy and commercial playbooks that will define Flexport’s approach to the territory going forward.

Prerequisites

  • 5+ years of experience managing complex, enterprise-level sales cycles with consistent quota attainment.
  • Proven ability to close large, multi-stakeholder deals with long sales cycles and high deal complexity.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior decision-makers.
  • Advanced discovery, negotiation, and value-based selling skills.
  • High degree of autonomy, strategic thinking, and commercial judgment.
  • Strong logistics, freight forwarding, or supply chain industry experience preferred.
  • Self-sufficient learner with a track record of ramping quickly in new markets, products, or environments without an established playbook to follow.
  • High level of intellectual curiosity — proactively seeks out market, product, and customer knowledge rather than waiting for it to be provided.
  • Deep understanding of the Irish market and local business landscape, with the credibility to engage enterprise buyers from day one.
  • Strong mix of supply chain/logistics industry knowledge and tech sales acumen, able to sell a platform-based solution with the same confidence as a traditional freight service.
  • High degree of agility and adaptability — comfortable operating with ambiguity and evolving priorities as the Irish territory is built out.

title: Senior Security Engineer, Detection & Response
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

What you'll do

There is no MSSP and no tier-1 queue here. Detection & Response engineers own their detections end to end: you write them, you tune them, and your team is paged when they fire. The security team is spread across the globe with a follow-the-sun pager rotation so nobody is paged at 3am local.

The adversaries are real. The business is growing fast and the threat surface is growing with it. Defining the necessary telemetry is part of the job.

Detection engineering

  • Build and tune detections across endpoint, identity, SaaS, and cloud, treating them as software: version-controlled, peer-reviewed, and shipped through the same CI/CD practices the rest of engineering uses.
  • Track detection quality as measured quantities: coverage against MITRE ATT&CK, precision, time-to-detect. We don’t build-and-forget here.

Response & automation

  • Own incident response: triage, contain, remediate, and write the retrospective that turns the incident into a systemic fix.
  • Build automation that removes toil from investigations, and partner closely with the US-based team so context carries across time zones instead of getting lost at handoff.

Telemetry & partnership

  • Define telemetry requirements for new systems before they ship, working with infrastructure and product teams to close visibility gaps rather than discovering them during an incident.
  • Threat hunt proactively across the estate, converting hypotheses into either new detections or documented coverage.

You Should Have

  • Typically 5–8 years of experience in detection engineering, incident response, or threat hunting, with real hands-on time writing and tuning detections. We care more about what you've built than the exact number.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, or similar) and comfort writing production-grade detection and automation code.
  • Experience with a modern SIEM or detection pipeline (Panther, Elastic, Splunk, or similar). What matters is that you've shipped and tuned detection logic in production.
  • Practical incident response experience: you've led or played a major role in triaging and closing out real security incidents.

Nice to have

  • Experience treating detections as code with CI/CD, peer review, and staged rollout.
  • Experience defining telemetry contracts for systems before they ship, rather than retrofitting logging after an incident.
  • A track record of critically evaluating and verifying AI-assisted work - testing, source-checking, validation - rather than trusting agent output by default. If you haven’t already spotted the em dashes in this job description and already thought about where the hiring manager (hi!) has put hands on keyboard and compared that to where they let the LLM watermarks through, you might not be the right person for the job.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native and Kubernetes telemetry.
  • Experience with fraud or financial-crime detection patterns.

How we work

  • We stay closely aligned with teammates on other continents via Slack, video, and async docs.
  • We have the latest hardware and software, including frontier AI models on day one.
  • We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best.

Why this role is special

  • You own your detections end to end, no MSSP, no tier-1 queue, no handing your work to someone else to triage.
  • The consequences here are physical, not abstract: a containment decision can stop a customs filing or freight actually moving, which makes the stakes concrete in a way a SaaS control plane rarely is.
  • You'll inherit a real, established estate with legacy telemetry gaps to close, genuinely underexplored surface area, not a well-mined problem.

The Opportunity: 

Flexport IT is looking for a Senior Systems Engineer (Identity & Access). In this role, you will design, implement, and administer our Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions to ensure secure, efficient user lifecycle management.

While you are our resident Okta expert, you are also a high-level IT generalist. You will oversee our broader SaaS ecosystem (Google Workspace, Slack, Jira) and endpoint management infrastructure (Jamf, Intune). Your expertise will drive automation, protect sensitive data, mitigate security risks, and maintain compliance in a heavily regulated industry.

You will continually strive towards automation of toil. If you are still manually doing the same operational tasks 18 months from now, something has gone wrong. Flexport’s book of business is growing fast, but the promise of technology is that we can grow our business faster than our headcount. The automation you build will be a key factor in that effort.

You Will

  • IAM Architecture: Design, implement, and maintain the end-to-end lifecycle of Identity and Access Management platforms.
  • Okta & Directory Trust: Administer Okta, directory services, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and advanced password management.
  • SaaS Operations: Manage core collaboration tools including Google Workspace, Microsoft O365, Slack, and Jira/Confluence.
  • Unified Endpoint Management: Oversee our global fleet of Mac and Windows devices using Jamf and MS Intune.
  • Lifecycle Automation: Build automated workflows for provisioning, deprovisioning, and application access.
  • Identity Governance: Establish role-based access control (RBAC), entitlement reviews, and access certification processes.
  • SSO Integration: Lead the technical onboarding of new SaaS applications for Single Sign-On (SSO).
  • Security Partnership: Collaborate closely with the Security team to embed security best practices into our IT infrastructure.
  • Documentation & Roadmaps: Author technical operating procedures, engineering roadmaps, and compliance policies.
  • Operations Support: Provide high-tier technical leadership and escalation support for complex IT operations.

You Should Have

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in IAM systems engineering paired with broad IT infrastructure management.
  • Okta Expertise: Deep, hands-on mastery of Okta configuration, policy creation, and application integration.
  • Core Protocols: Strong knowledge of IAM standards including SAML, SCIM, OAuth, OIDC, IGA, RBAC, and LDAP.
  • Automation Skills: Experience with scripting (e.g., Python, Bash, or PowerShell) and Okta Workflows to automate IT tasks.
  • SaaS & Endpoint Ecosystem: Proven track record managing Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, Jamf (macOS), and Intune (Windows).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical engineering experience.
  • Compliance Mindset: A "compliance-first" attitude to navigate the rigorous requirements of a heavily regulated industry.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving abilities paired with strong collaborative and interpersonal communication.

title: Security Engineer, Corporate Security
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

All security disciplines work under the umbrella of the combined PSI (Platform, Security & Infrastructure) team: we build the paved path and tooling that hundreds of engineers around the world rely on every day to ship. Corporate Security owns the estate everyone at Flexport actually touches — the laptops, the identity provider, the SaaS sprawl, the browser. Get it right and nobody notices. Get it wrong and it's the fastest way into everything else we're trying to protect.

This is a security engineering role, not an IT support role. You'll spend your time writing code and shipping automation, not administering a helpdesk queue or babysitting a ticket tray.

What you'll do

  • Identity & access
    • Advance our identity posture: SSO coverage, phishing-resistant MFA rollout, SCIM lifecycle automation, and least-privilege access across the SaaS and cloud estate.
    • Build the detections and guardrails that catch account takeover, MFA fatigue attacks, and session token theft before they turn into incidents.
  • Endpoint & device lifecycle
    • Write and ship device policy as code — configuration profiles, remediation scripts, and enforcement rules across macOS and Windows — with staged rollout and rollback built in from day one.
    • Maintain and improve our EDR stack's detection and response coverage across the fleet.
  • SaaS posture
    • Reduce SaaS risk at scale through SSPM tooling and automation, including detection of risky OAuth grants, shadow IT, and configuration drift across our critical SaaS applications.
    • Own security configuration for the SaaS tools hundreds of Flexporters use daily (Google Workspace, Slack, and similar), and keep pace as we add AI agents and MCP integrations to that surface.
  • Automation & enablement
    • Automate the parts of corporate security that don't need a human — device provisioning, access reviews, vendor security questionnaires — so the team scales with headcount instead of straining against it.
    • Write runbooks and documentation that make the rest of the team more capable, and partner with IT and People teams to ship controls that don't create the friction that drives people to workarounds.

You should have

  • Typically 2–5 years of experience in corporate, enterprise, or IT security engineering — we care more about what you've shipped than the exact number. If you meet most of this, apply; we'd rather see your work than filter you out on a résumé line.
  • Hands-on experience with modern endpoint management and EDR tooling (Jamf, Kandji, Intune, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or similar).
  • Working knowledge of identity protocols (SAML, OIDC, SCIM) and a major identity provider (Okta, Entra, Google Workspace, or similar).
  • Comfort writing real code or scripts (Python, Go, or similar) to replace manual, ticket-driven work with automation.
  • Clear, practical communicator who can explain a control tradeoff to an engineer, a salesperson, and a VP without changing the facts.

Nice to have

  • Experience with SSPM tooling and OAuth-grant governance.
  • Exposure to DLP or insider-risk tooling.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) for managing security configuration.
  • A point of view on how agentic AI tools and MCP integrations change what corporate security needs to watch for
  • Interest in growing into a broader corporate security or detection engineering scope over time.

How we work

  • We're in the San Francisco office regularly to work through incidents and detection design in person.
  • We stay closely aligned with teammates on other continents via Slack, video, and async docs.
  • We have the latest hardware and software, including frontier AI models on day one.
  • We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best.

Why this role is special

  • Broad, real ownership: at this level elsewhere you might own a slice of a control; here you'll own well-defined projects end to end, from design through rollout, with support scoping the ambiguous parts.
  • Every device policy or identity control you ship protects every Flexporter, immediately — no six-month rollout to a subset of customers.
  • You're part of PSI: security is treated as infrastructure to build, not policy to enforce, and platform and infrastructure engineers are a Slack message away.

Where you'll work

This role is based in San Francisco, and we have a strong preference for candidates who are there or willing to relocate — we're deliberately building this team in one place. Relocation support is available for the right candidate.

Investing your time with Flexport means having immediate impact, all over the world. You're empowered to do what's best for everyone and trusted to make the right decisions when and where you need them. Join our collective of entrepreneurs and improve the world's experience in global trade.

descriptionHtml:

Build the operational and technical skill set that runs global trade

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. We're shaping the future of a $10T industry with technology and people who understand it end to end. The Rotational Development Program (RDP) exists because that combination — real supply chain fluency plus the ability to build and automate — doesn't exist at scale in the market today. So we're building it ourselves.

This is an 18-month program, not a rotation for rotation's sake. Every assignment is live, revenue-generating work. Every participant leaves with a certification in AI and low-code tooling running alongside their operational and commercial training. And every graduate places into a role with real scope: primarily Account Management, with paths into Automation Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering/Consulting, Sales Engineering, or a traditional Ops/Sales/Customs track.

What you'll do

You'll rotate through three functions, six months each, with AI/low-code curriculum running continuously across all three:

  • Gateway Ops (Air or Ocean). Own the shipment lifecycle. Execute bookings, manage exceptions, and hold data integrity to Flexport's standard. Build your first automation and reporting skills through structured coursework running in parallel.
  • Customs. Become a global trade expert by navigating the complex world of customs regulations to ensure goods comply with international laws. Simultaneously, move into applied technical work: SQL, workflow automation, Lean process improvement, etc.
  • Sales / Account Management. Take on go-to-market work and build client-facing skills, operating with more independence. Your capstone: identify a real business problem in the function you're sitting in and build the tooling or process fix that solves it. You'll present it to leadership at graduation.

Throughout the program, you'll get:

  • A day-to-day manager in your current rotation and a Rotation Program Manager tracking your development, with mid-point and end-of-rotation evaluations at every stage.
  • Certifications in AI/low-code tooling, from foundational bootcamp through applied builds to a capstone project.
  • Bi-weekly cohort touchpoints and a standing alumni mentor community.
  • Increased earning potential as you clear program benchmarks

This role is for you if you

  • Are on track to graduate, or recently graduated, and want to build a career at the intersection of supply chain operations and technology — not just run one or the other.
  • Are genuinely curious about AI and low-code tooling and want to build real fluency, not just check a resume box.
  • Can operate with minimal supervision, prioritize a high volume of work, and communicate clearly under pressure.
  • Want real ownership fast? This program hands you live client and business work from the very beginning — it is not a shadowing or classroom based program.
  • Have a "compliance-first" mindset. We operate in a heavily regulated industry, and that matters in every rotation.

Ready to build the future of global trade — and the skill set to run it?

Apply now.

  • Demonstrate strong ability to problem solve and escalate
  • Bring enriched industry knowledge and ability to apply accordingly

You should have: 

  • Bachelor/master degree
  • At least 8 years of experience in sales, account management and supply chain operations roles, preferably in managerial or team lead level positions.

Examples of activities you might find yourself doing with include: leading a discovery call with a prospect to uncover information about their supply chain processes, discussing an onboarding strategy with a fellow Flexporter across our offices, meeting with a prospective client to set up a trial project, or sharing your best practices with the broader sales team in a peer learning session.

You will:

  • Proactively consult with clients to understand their logistics and supply chain needs  through a solutions-based selling approach.

  • Establish and implement systems methods and processes to build scalable commercial capabilities.
  • Teamwork with with Account Manager to drive client success and revenue generation
  • Provide insightful market intel and data analysis. 
  • Identify opportunities for account growth by having a thorough understanding of Flexport’s diversified, and growing product line while retaining and expanding revenue within the book of business.
  • Collaborate with Flexport’s client operations teams to identify upsell opportunities, source pipeline, and develop strategic account plans.

You should have:

  • 5 - 8 years of experience in commercial and analytics heavy functions.
  • You’re not afraid to get your hands dirty and will thrive in unstructured and multi-stakeholder settings to deliver results.
  • Proven relationship management, and project/program/process management skills.
  • Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done
  • Demonstrated ability to run a sales discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process
  • Proven success building and maintaining long term commercial relationships
  • Ability to deliver on a broad portfolio of responsibilities on your own, and ‘figure stuff out’ quickly and effectively.
  • Great with numbers including strong analytical skills.
  • A strong grasp of real world supply chain concepts including direct knowledge of how industrial and product supply chains work.
  • Knowledge in Greater China regions logistics, freight forwarding. 
  • Highly effective communicator with good people instincts - able to build trust and work well with a diverse group internally and externally.
  • Eager for a very hands-on role, where you’ll be asked to take on and run with a range of projects outside your comfort zone, and learn quickly.
  • Strong command of English and Chinese.

descriptionHtml:

The opportunity:

The role of the Global Operations Associate is a critical part of making Flexport’s mission to make global trade easy for everyone a reality. To achieve this the Global Operations Team is at the heart of delighting our customers, managing our partners and working closely with our technology partners to drive innovation through process automation. With our focus on developing a global network, our operational teams are strategically located across the world to manage and execute our services and products offered to our customers and partners. Flexport Global Operations raises the bar by using data to manage our customer’s supply chains and identifies opportunities to improve fidelity in planning, responsiveness and overall execution.

As a Global Operations Associate, you are an expert in executing the end-to-end movement of shipments within a regional network.

On a day-to-day basis you will coordinate the supply chain operations with ocean activities within your region. 

This role will focus on driving a first in class customer experience by obsessing over quality and on time performance. Lastly, this role will work very closely with peers and supervisors to problem solve. 

You will:

  • Be the 'front line' in ensuring the highest standard of Flexport quality: shipments move on-time, exceptions are handled proactively, and clients receive a first-class experience through timely, clear communication.
  • Be responsible for ensuring your work satisfies internal KPIs and SLAs that demonstrate quality delivery, independently managing your priorities and commitments.
  • Follow standard operating procedures (SOP) and proactively flag opportunities for improvement.
  • Solve client issues quickly and ensure smooth operations at origin and destination, developing solutions independently and escalating to senior team members as needed
  • Act in the best interest of the company by avoiding leakages and ensuring cost conscious behavior. 
  • Seamlessly coordinate day-to-day operations with the relevant internal and external partners for your team's scope (e.g. carriers, vendors, customs, regional trade lane management, cross-functional stakeholders, etc)
  • Execute the end-to-end movement of freight shipments within a regional network (both imports and exports), including intermodal movements.
  • Assist the shipments managed by partners as we drive partner autonomy and parity with insourced operations (if applicable in a given region).
  • Use data and operational tools to inform decisions, identify patterns in your work, and contribute to efficiency improvements.

Requirements:

  • BA/BS Degree or completed professional training as forwarding agent.
  • 2+ years of experience in operations, logistics or freight forwarding
  • Have a technology (and AI)first mindset and can thrive in a fast paced environment.
  • Effective time management. Be able to properly prioritize and manage a large volume of tasks.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Ability to effectively seek and receive feedback.
  • Effective communication both verbally and in writing.
  • Teamwork and relationship building.
  • Orientation towards working smarter and adopting best practices and standardization.
  • Problem-solving capabilities.
  • A “compliance first” attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.
  • A client service mindset; you are obsessed with client satisfaction, and strive to investigate and troubleshoot the client’s problem.
  • Language requirement: Mandatory German and fluency in English.

What's in there for you: 

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment
  • Lunch food delivery 4 days a week incl. vegetarian options, a salad bar and special menu options, plus breakfast options, snacks, soft drinks and barista coffee.
  • Health insurance:  employee contribution part is covered by Flexport
  • 25 paid vacation days
  • Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.
  • Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members
  • Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.

This role reports to the Manager, Trucking & Warehouse (based in Ho Chi Minh City) and is a senior, high-autonomy position: you are expected to be the go-to person in Vietnam, capable of resolving day-to-day issues independently, and proactively improving how the team works 

Daily Operations & Execution

  • Coordinate domestic trucking bookings: trucking only, or trucking attached to ocean and air shipments across Vietnam, including EXW pickups, port runs, and cross-dock moves.
  • Fulfill ad-hoc trucking, CFS, and storage service requests from internal teams and clients.
  • Track shipment and warehouse milestones, ensuring Flexport systems are updated accurately and KPIs are met.
  • Act as the first point of contact for on-site issues in Hanoi, resolving delays, exceptions, and service issues directly with vendors and warehouse operators before escalating.

Warehouse & CFS Operations

  • Liaise with CFS/warehouse vendors to ensure service quality, safety compliance, and cost efficiency.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks in warehouse workflows and recommend practical improvements.

Vendor Management

  • Maintain and grow relationships with domestic trucking, CFS, and warehouse vendors in Vietnam.
  • Lead vendor onboarding, including collecting documents, negotiating rates, and building service profiles.
  • Own and maintain the domestic trucking and CFS rate database, keeping Flexport's systems accurate and up to date.
  • Monitor vendor performance, flag quality or reliability issues, and drive corrective action.

SOPs, Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Design, document, and maintain SOPs for daily trucking, CFS, and warehouse operations.
  • Build and maintain regular operational reports and dashboards to track performance, cost, and service KPIs.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks or build lightweight tools/platforms that improve team productivity.
  • Share best practices and process documentation with the wider team to standardize ways of working across locations.

New Business Support

  • Support RFQ responses for domestic trucking and CFS/warehousing by gathering vendor rates and capacity information.
  • Partner with the Manager, Product team (Ocean/Air), and Demand team on solution design and costing for new client opportunities.
  • Prepare rate sheets and trucking/warehousing lane summaries for client proposals.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in logistics, supply chain, business, or a related field.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in trucking, freight forwarding, warehousing/CFS, or logistics operations, with at least 1 year in a role requiring independent ownership.
  • Hands-on experience with warehouse and CFS operations is required; experience setting up or improving CFS workflows is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrated experience building or improving SOPs and operational reporting in a previous role.
  • Genuine interest in automation and process improvement — comfortable with Excel/GSheet formulas, macros, or basic tools/scripts; experience with TMS or building simple internal tools is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Vietnam's domestic trucking and warehousing/CFS market
  • Fluent working English (able to lead calls and written communication with overseas teams).
  • Proactive, solutions-oriented communicator who flags problems early and drives resolution without needing close supervision.

What You'll Gain

  • Hands-on expertise in domestic trucking operations and Vietnam's logistics ecosystem.
  • Direct exposure to vendor management, RFQ processes, and new business solutioning.
  • A clear growth path as Flexport Vietnam scales.
  • Mentorship from experienced operations leads and cross-functional exposure to ocean, customs, and account management teams.

As a senior operations associate focusing on product, you are expected to utilize knowledge of the end-to-end shipment operations process and be equipped with a process-driven, data-driven, and continuous improvement mindset to deliver results in one or multiple areas:

Responsibilities:

  • When there are associates or specialists in your team, you will be responsible for supervising, coaching, and monitoring their performance.
  • You will use metrics to guide your team to improve and deliver great performance and enhance their hard skills and soft skills.
  • You will personally represent Flexport’s value proposition by leading and driving the progress of tasks and projects in your scope to contribute to operational excellence.
  • Your detailed scope and responsibilities will include:

Product Improvement:

  • You will work closely with internal teams in APAC Ocean Gateway Operations to have an effective process to collaborate with the Tech team.
  • You can understand how the latest processes and products interact with each other and the background behind them in order to represent or facilitate the operations team in talking to the Tech team.
  • You can think and communicate structurally to explain the operations process, product needs, and impact, or put together a BRD (Business Request Document) or ticket to help the Tech team understand.
  • You have the team and company goals in mind and shepherd the business team to properly prioritize the product requests when facing resource constraints.
  • You are able to maintain a good relationship with different relevant Tech teams and properly push the Tech team to provide resource commitment and drive product feature delivery. Know who to escalate to when it is required.
  • You are sensitive and creative enough to capture opportunities to productize an operations process and initiate product improvement projects.
  • You are able to work with people at different levels and different teams. You can pull people from different teams to work toward a common goal.
  • You can effectively provide updates to stakeholders on key issues that may impact project completion, budget, or other results


Process Optimization:

  • You will work closely with internal teams in the APAC Ocean team to cultivate a continuous process improvement mindset and support the team in identifying areas to improve with data. 
  • You can understand the background behind an existing process and support the operations team to find solutions to optimize the process to drive down costs to serve and increase operational efficiency.

  • You can represent or facilitate the APAC Ocean Gateway Operations team to discuss, negotiate, or align on a process design and implementation, but also can think of the overall gains.
  • You can be open to listening to different parties’ input and think from an execution perspective, but also consider the company’s benefits as a whole to design an actionable and effective process.
  • You can develop metrics to measure the success of a process change and establish the mechanism to monitor the trend post-launch.
  • You are able to work with people at different levels and different teams. You can pull people from different teams to work toward a common goal.
  • You can effectively provide updates to stakeholders on key issues that may impact project completion, budget, or other results.

What you will need:

Experience:

  • BA/BS degree
  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain, ocean carrier operations, or consulting
  • Excellent command of both spoken and written English and Chinese/Mandarin.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Proven ability to build strong, cohesive relationships with the business, operations, technology, and other key stakeholders
  • Data-driven, strong analytical and logical sense
  • Strong attention to detail and proficient problem-solving skills.
  • Strong sense of prioritization and ability to execute deliverables

Mindset:

We’re looking for folks who have:

  • Desire to “build a better machine” and get irritated when things aren’t optimal
  • Demonstrated ability to lead small teams in day-to-day execution
  • Hands-on, process-oriented, structured thinking with strong problem-solving capabilities 
  • Strategic vision and ground-floor execution
  • Excitement to exercise your leadership skills to pull people together
  • Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it!
  • Flexibility to get the job done when needed. Willing to work outside office hours and occasional weekend or night shifts in certain locations.

Skills:

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills
  • Good command of both spoken and written English and Chinese/Mandarin
  • Optimizing processes analytically
  • Building feedback loops for a product or project
  • Problem-Solving 4: Building consensus among people with strongly differing opinions
  • Managing time and commitments
  • Generating ideas through data
  • Forming hypotheses and developing experiments
  • Framing problems
  • Investigating and troubleshooting operations problems
  • Solving problems through hypothesis-based root cause analysis

Growth and development:

Skills you can advance in this role:

  • All of the above +
  • Coaching your colleagues
  • Encouraging your team to improve how the team works
  • Helping your team learn from performance outcomes
  • Inspiring your team
  • Organizing, leading, and participating in meetings
  • Project delivery ability
  • Cross-team communication skills
  • Process and metrics design skills

What you will learn:

  • You will gain the skills necessary to lead a team of increasing scale and function. You will learn how to be a player-coach who apprentices team members in skill development.
  • You will learn what it takes to effectively drive people from different teams but not directly report to you: holding them accountable while also creating win-win opportunities.
  • You will learn how to thrive in an ambiguous environment, research and implement hypotheses, and inform the strategy of a newly built team.
  • You will learn how to facilitate discussion, decision-making, and conflict resolution.

The opportunity:

The role of the Operations Associate is a critical part of making Flexport’s mission to make global trade easy for everyone a reality. Flexport today connects almost 10,000 clients and suppliers across 109 countries. In this role, your direct customers are the partners within your region: our account management and customs teams, subcontractors, carriers, terminals and trucking providers. Your work directly supports Flexport’s end customers in achieving their logistics goals. Most importantly, you will play a pivotal role in building the next operational model at Flexport: allowing us to effectively scale to achieve our mission of making global trade easier for everyone.

This role is designed to facilitate the movement of shipments while discovering and driving efficiencies that build and improve operations as part of our Global team. You will be responsible for ensuring that all customer shipments are executed according to plan, on time and within budget. As the person who manages movement in your region with laser focus, you have the unique opportunity to help your regional account team spot opportunities to improve and grow our customers’ business. You will drive impact through surfacing new ideas to eliminate waste, improve customer experience or introducing innovative ways of managing a supply chain.

Responsibilities:

  • Be the “front line” in ensuring the highest standard of Flexport quality: shipments move on-time and exceptions are handled appropriately
  • Be responsible for ensuring your work satisfies internal KPIs and SLAs that demonstrate quality delivery
  • Follow standard operating procedures (SOP)
  • Solve client issues quickly and ensure smooth operations at origin and destination and escalate issues as needed
  • Acting in the best interest of the company by avoiding leakages and ensuring cost conscious behavior 
  • Seamlessly coordinate day-to-day logistics operations with internal and external partners such as steamship lines, air carriers, intermodal and drayage vendors, customs, trade lane management, warehousing, transloading, trucking, and the air operations team
  • Execute the end-to-end movement of freight shipments within a regional network (both imports and exports), including intermodal movements
  • Assist the shipments managed by partners as we drive partner autonomy (if applicable in a given region)

title: Sales Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Location: Seoul

Reporting: Country Manager

Position : Individual Contributor

Role Overview

As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for acquiring and developing net-new mid-market customers through a consultative, value-based sales approach.

This role requires a strong hunter mentality and the ability to independently build and manage a pipeline from prospecting through close. You will work with customers to understand their logistics and supply chain challenges, identify opportunities for improvement, and position Flexport's technology and services as a broader business solution—not simply as a freight or transportation provider.

A successful AE is able to move customer conversations beyond price and transactional freight discussions by demonstrating the broader value Flexport can deliver through its platform, visibility, technology, and operational capabilities.

Pipeline & Opportunity Ownership

  • Independently identify, prospect, and close net-new mid-market customers, meeting or exceeding individual sales targets.
  • Build and manage a healthy pipeline through self-sourced prospecting, outbound outreach, referrals, networking, and other channels.
  • Own the full sales cycle from initial prospecting and qualification through negotiation and close.
  • Qualify opportunities based on customer needs, business priorities, timing, and strategic fit—not solely on immediate price competitiveness.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity management and forecasting in Salesforce (SFDC).
  • Maintain clear ownership of next steps and momentum throughout the sales cycle.

Customer Discovery & Value-Based Selling

  • Lead discovery conversations with prospective customers to understand their logistics, supply chain, and business challenges.
  • Engage relevant stakeholders and uncover the underlying needs, priorities, and decision criteria behind a customer's requirements.
  • Understand when a customer is primarily focused on price and effectively reframe the conversation around total value, operational efficiency, visibility, technology, and service quality.
  • Demonstrate the ability to challenge a customer's existing approach and introduce new perspectives on how logistics can create business value.
  • Translate customer needs into tailored Flexport solutions and articulate a compelling value proposition.
  • Conduct effective customer presentations, platform demonstrations, and solution discussions in both remote and in-person settings.

Deal Management & Closing

  • Manage opportunities from qualification through negotiation and close with clear ownership and consistent sales momentum.
  • Develop compelling commercial proposals that connect Flexport's solution to the customer's business priorities.
  • Lead commercial discussions and negotiations within Flexport's pricing and contracting frameworks.
  • Avoid competing solely on price and clearly communicate the value and differentiation of Flexport's platform and services.
  • Coordinate with internal teams such as Operations, Solutions, Finance, and Legal when required to progress opportunities.

Onboarding & Account Development

  • Partner with internal teams to ensure a smooth transition from sales to customer onboarding and execution.
  • Establish trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders from the early stages of the customer lifecycle.
  • Identify opportunities to expand and deepen customer relationships based on evolving customer needs.

Prerequisites

  • 3+ years of B2B sales experience with a proven track record of managing the full sales cycle from prospecting to close.
  • Proven ability to independently build pipelines and acquire new customers without relying on a dedicated SDR.
  • Strong consultative and value-based selling skills, with the ability to move customer conversations beyond price and transactional requirements.
  • Strong discovery, communication, presentation, negotiation, and commercial judgment skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple opportunities and stakeholders while maintaining sales momentum.
  • Native Korean + Fluent in English.

Preferred

  • Experience in logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain, SaaS, technology, or other solution-oriented B2B sales.
  • Experience selling in a price-sensitive market or successfully differentiating a solution based on business value rather than price alone.

locations: New York City, New York, United States
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Build the operational and technical skill set that runs global trade

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. We're shaping the future of a $10T industry with technology and people who understand it end to end. The Rotational Development Program (RDP) exists because that combination — real supply chain fluency plus the ability to build and automate — doesn't exist at scale in the market today. So we're building it ourselves.

This is an 18-month program, not a rotation for rotation's sake. Every assignment is live, revenue-generating work. Every participant leaves with a certification in AI and low-code tooling running alongside their operational and commercial training. And every graduate places into a role with real scope: primarily Account Management, with paths into Automation Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering/Consulting, Sales Engineering, or a traditional Ops/Sales/Customs track.

What you'll do

You'll rotate through three functions, six months each, with AI/low-code curriculum running continuously across all three:

  • Gateway Ops (Air or Ocean). Own the shipment lifecycle. Execute bookings, manage exceptions, and hold data integrity to Flexport's standard. Build your first automation and reporting skills through structured coursework running in parallel.
  • Customs. Become a global trade expert by navigating the complex world of customs regulations to ensure goods comply with international laws. Simultaneously, move into applied technical work: SQL, workflow automation, Lean process improvement, etc.
  • Sales / Account Management. Take on go-to-market work and build client-facing skills, operating with more independence. Your capstone: identify a real business problem in the function you're sitting in and build the tooling or process fix that solves it. You'll present it to leadership at graduation.

Throughout the program, you'll get:

  • A day-to-day manager in your current rotation and a Rotation Program Manager tracking your development, with mid-point and end-of-rotation evaluations at every stage.
  • Certifications in AI/low-code tooling, from foundational bootcamp through applied builds to a capstone project.
  • Bi-weekly cohort touchpoints and a standing alumni mentor community.
  • Increased earning potential as you clear program benchmarks

This role is for you if you

  • Are on track to graduate, or recently graduated, and want to build a career at the intersection of supply chain operations and technology — not just run one or the other.
  • Are genuinely curious about AI and low-code tooling and want to build real fluency, not just check a resume box.
  • Can operate with minimal supervision, prioritize a high volume of work, and communicate clearly under pressure.
  • Want real ownership fast? This program hands you live client and business work from the very beginning — it is not a shadowing or classroom based program.
  • Have a "compliance-first" mindset. We operate in a heavily regulated industry, and that matters in every rotation.

Ready to build the future of global trade — and the skill set to run it?

Apply now.

About the Team

The Treasury function manages regional cash liquidity, payments, and banking relationships across 16 APAC entities and 33+ bank accounts (JPM, HSBC, BOC, ICBC, CMB, DBS, IBK, ABA). 

Job Summary

Flexport is hiring a Treasury Analyst to own execution of APAC's regular and emergency bill payments across host-to-host and manual bank channels for all APAC entities — and to support the Senior Treasury & Payment Analyst on bank reconciliation, cashflow forecasting, and bank guarantee administration. This is a foundational treasury role suited to someone early in their treasury or banking operations career who wants exposure to a fast-growing, multi-entity, multi-currency environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Process regular weekly and emergency/ad hoc bill payments for all APAC entities via host-to-host (~80% of volume) and manual bank portal execution (~20%).
  • Review and verify bill payment details before setting payments, including country-specific tax checks (e.g., Thailand VAT/WHT verification for eWHT certificates), to ensure accuracy before submission.
  • Compile and submit payment lists to the US team for approval, then execute approved payments in NetSuite and JPM (and other banking portals).
  • Support monthly bank reconciliation across ~33 APAC bank accounts ahead of month-end close.
  • Support cashflow monitoring and forecasting across the 16 entities the Treasury team covers.
  • Support administration of Flexport APAC bank guarantees, including tracking renewals and coordinating documentation requests.
  • Support new bank account opening for geo-expansion markets (upcoming China Ningbo, New Zealand) — preparing documentation, application forms, and KYC materials.
  • Support to maintain and update banking documentation, including authorized signer lists, director/legal representative records, and bank callback lists.
  • Partner with AR, AP, and Accounting to resolve discrepancies between bank data, NetSuite, and Core.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field.
  • 1-3 years of experience in payment processing, treasury, or banking operations.
  • Comfortable working across multiple banking portals and high daily payment volumes with strong attention to detail and accuracy under deadline pressure.
  • Strong Excel skills; experience with NetSuite or similar ERP systems is a plus.
  • Proficiency in Mandarin and English, both written and spoken, to support regional stakeholders and local bank relationships.
  • Organized and reliable with recurring, deadline-driven processes (daily/weekly payment cycles, month-end close).

You'll report directly to the Director of Finance, lead a small team of accountants, and have real hands-on impact from day one.

This is a seat for a builder. You'll work alongside a team that is heavily adopting autonomous finance, shaping it and learning from it firsthand. As automation takes over the standard recurring work, your time goes to judgement, including setting up accounting for new countries, new commercial models, and building controls that hold up across borders. Sharp analytical thinking and high-quality judgement in financial reporting and VAT are what will make you successful here.

You will:

  • Own full monthly close process across the region.
  • Own accuracy of local Revenue and COGS, including transfer pricing calculations, based on approved methodology.
  • Control cost, protect balance sheet and liquidity through among others OPEX and T&E challenge, financial anomaly investigation, and cash flow review.
  • Own correctness of input and output VAT recording end-to-end based on strong acumen on EU and international VAT principles, including managing claims, notices and e-invoicing readiness for compliance with continuous transaction control mandates.
  • Build and deliver on automation roadmap, within and outside the ERP, by surfacing manual and repeatable work, and sequencing its removal.
  • Partner with the business and other back office functions (Legal, People, Workplace) to catch new transaction structures before they hit the ledger.
  • Lead and develop the accounting team.

You’ll thrive here if:

  • You've run accounting and VAT hands-on across several European countries, and you go into the detail when something looks off.
  • You'd rather fix a broken process than escalate it, and you can tell when you need to align and when to decide.
  • You're comfortable making decisions with limited information in a fast-scaling environment.
  • You see AI as a way to raise the quality of your judgement, not replace it.

You should have: 

  • 8+ years of progressive accounting and finance operations experience in a high-growth, multinational company.
  • Proven hands-on ownership of VAT accounting and compliance across Europe.
  • Strong GAAP/IFRS, financial reporting and ERP background.
  • Hands-on experience deploying automated finance tools and modern data stacks.
  • Clear communication with stakeholders at every level, both internal and external.

What is in it for you:

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment.

  • Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.

descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The Opportunity

The Manager, Americas Control Tower leads the execution strategy for ocean and air freight operations across North and Latin America, based out of Flexport’s Guadalajara office. This role is responsible for driving operational excellence through consistent process execution, quality management, and standardization across regions, panning Ocean (FCL/LCL) and Air, and Flexport’s growing Control Tower product suite. The Operations Manager oversees the daily performance of their team’s workflows, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to service standards. A key focus of this role is developing scalable, repeatable processes that enhance efficiency and consistency across pre-departure tasks, while also overseeing select post-arrival functions owned by the Control Tower. This position works closely with regional Gateway, Carrier Performance Management, and Demand teams to identify performance gaps, implement best practices, and align stakeholders around a shared goal: delivering a seamless, best-in-class experience for our clients.

Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Control Tower Development

  • Build, lead, and develop a team of Gateway Operators within the Americas Control Tower, able to execute across both ocean and air modes
  • Serve as the primary leadership presence for the Americas Control Tower from day one; act as the bridge between Control Tower operators and regional Gateway leadership teams
  • Establish clear escalation protocols, communication rhythms, and performance standards between the Control Tower and its regional counterparts
  • Lead weekend and after-hours coverage planning for accounts requiring extended support

Operational Performance

  • Oversee exception management workflows: dwelling cargo, document discrepancies, milestone gaps, line holds, and carrier SLA resolution
  • Ensure flexibility is maintained across ocean and air modes; gateway operators flex between modes based on volume and account needs
  • Act as a client-facing escalation point for high-priority issues, partnering with Account Management and Demand to ensure client expectations are met and communicated clearly
  • Partner with Americas ops leaders on outbound forecasting, terminal dwell, milestone accuracy, and timely carrier communication

Process, Standards & Scalability

  • Develop and maintain SOPs for all Control Tower-managed functions; ensure consistent, repeatable, and compliant execution across modes and accounts
  • Generate SLAs for the Control Tower team aligned with regional and company-wide goals

Stakeholder Partnership & Reporting

  • Develop dashboards and reporting to measure team performance; support regional leadership in data-driven decisions on carrier strategy and account management
  • Collaborate with Carrier Performance Management and Demand teams to surface insights from Control Tower-managed shipments
  • Partner with product leaders to develop product strategy that supports Control Tower execution needs

Hiring & Team Growth

  • Plan for headcount, hire, grow, and manage a high-performing team as scope expands
  • Identify and develop team leads from within the operator cohort as the Control Tower matures

Experience Needed:

  • BA/BS degree and/or 5+ years of experience in relevant freight forwarding, transportation, or supply chain roles
  • 3+ years of people management experience in a relevant freight forwarding, transportation, or supply chain role required
  • English and Spanish language fluency required, as the role requires professional-level Spanish for team leadership and shipper/carrier coordination
  • In-depth knowledge of freight forwarding technology and platforms; experience partnering with product teams to deliver operational improvements
  • Analytical, metrics-driven approach to problem solving; strong working knowledge of analytical tools (Looker, BI dashboards, AI, Google Suite/Microsoft Suite, etc.)
  • Experience developing and enforcing SOPs in a high-volume operational environment
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills, including the confidence to represent Flexport directly to clients and carriers; ability to manage effectively across time zones and cultural contexts

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Portuguese language proficiency
  • Ability and willingness to travel to the US as needed

Worried about not having any freight forwarding experience?

  • Don’t be! We’re building the first Operating System for Global Trade. That’s why it’s incredibly important for us to bring people from diverse backgrounds and experiences together with our industry veterans to help move the freight forwarding industry forward.
  • What’s freight forwarding and why does it matter? Listen to Ryan, our CEO explain what freight forwarding is and why improving global trade can help to connect the world and break down economic barriers in this Fast Company Freethink Original Series video.
  • We know this industry is complex. That’s why we invest in education starting day one with Flexport Academy, a one week intensive onboarding program designed specifically to set every new Flexport employee up for success.

The Opportunity

You will own credit and collections for Flexport across Asia Pacific and be the partner to APAC leadership and every country leader on customer risk. You will take Flexport’s global credit framework and adapt it to APAC, tailoring policy, terms and limits to each market’s practices and making sure the business applies them consistently. You will also run collections for the region, keeping receivables current and cash coming in. As Flexport expands across APAC, you will extend this framework to new countries, supported by the automation and risk tools developed by our US Corporate Credit team.

If you want to protect Flexport’s capital while helping the business win more trade in Asia, you belong here.

Scope:

  • Regional Ownership: Manage Flexport’s credit and collections function across Asia Pacific, covering every market where we operate.
  • Expansion Support: Support Flexport’s growth across the region, rolling out credit for new countries, entities and products as they launch.
  • Policy Localization: Adapt Flexport’s global credit policy and processes to APAC markets, adding country-specific rules where local practice requires it.
  • Function Building: Scale a robust credit function in the region, from decisioning and monitoring to collections and reporting.

You Will:

  • Localize Credit Policy: Apply Flexport’s global credit framework to each APAC country and adapt it to local legal, regulatory, tax, currency and payment practices
  • Partner with APAC Leadership: Serve as the credit partner to APAC leadership and each country leader. Align credit strategy with commercial goals, present portfolio risk, and make clear, timely calls on high-impact requests.
  • Own the APAC Portfolio: Monitor exposure, aging and concentration, and spot emerging risk early so issues are handled before accounts go past due.
  • Lead Regional Collections: Own collections across APAC, from dunning strategy and past-due follow-up to payment plans, dispute resolution and escalation to external agencies or legal partners. Work with country teams to keep DSO and past-due balances within target.
  • Adopt US-Built Automation: Work with the US Corporate Credit and Credit Science teams to deploy credit scoring, monitoring and workflow tools in APAC. Define local requirements and drive adoption with country teams.
  • Apply Freight Forwarding Practice: Bring proven methods for managing credit with shippers, consignees, overseas agents and carriers, including duties, outlays, freight collect and cargo-release controls.
  • Manage External Partners: Own relationships with local credit bureaus, credit insurers, banks and collection or legal partners across the region.
  • Report and Govern: Deliver regular APAC portfolio reviews to regional and global Finance leadership, and keep the region compliant with policy and ready for audit.

You Should Have:

Hard Skills

  • 10+ years of experience in commercial credit and collections, with at least 5 years leading credit and collections across multiple APAC countries.
  • Industry: Freight forwarding, logistics or shipping credit experience strongly preferred.
  • Policy Implementation: Proven record of rolling out and adapting credit policy across several jurisdictions.
  • Collections: Track record of running collections and reducing past-due balances and DSO.
  • Regional Knowledge: Working knowledge of credit, collections and enforcement practices across APAC markets.
  • Financial Judgment: Sound financial statement analysis and judgment on complex or high-exposure accounts. Comfortable making decisions from data and automated tools; coding not required.
  • Languages: Fluent English. Mandarin or Cantonese preferred; other APAC languages a plus.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or Business (required). MBA, CPA or credit certification are a plus.

Soft Skills

  • Executive Presence: Able to influence senior commercial leaders and country managers, and to say no when the risk isn’t right.
  • Cross-Cultural Leadership: Builds trust with teams across very different markets and business cultures.
  • Ownership: Takes full accountability for the region with little direction.
  • Communication: A clear, persuasive communicator, both written and verbal, at every level of the organization.
  • Flexibility: Willing to travel across APAC and work across US and EU time zones.
  • Collaboration: A team player who makes cross-functional partners better.

Why Flexport:

You’ll join a credit team that operates with the agility of a startup and the data advantage of a global logistics leader. You’ll lead credit and collections for one of Flexport’s most important regions, building on an established global framework and automation already built for you to deploy, with direct access to APAC and global Finance leadership. If that’s the kind of impact you’re after, let’s talk.

The Opportunity:

We are currently seeking individuals for a full-time position that involves operating one of our inaugural fulfillment centers in Phillipsburg, NJ. As a key member of the Flexport team, you will take on the role of a people leader, responsible for managing a process and a team on the operating floor. This position offers a unique opportunity to invest in others and cultivate a collaborative leadership style. By utilizing the tools, processes, and operations that drive Flexport's mission to make global trade easy for everyone, you will contribute to shaping the future of logistics. We are looking for high-potential candidates who are eager to take on this challenge and be part of our dynamic and innovative organization. Join us in our mission to revolutionize global trade and make a lasting impact on the industry.

You will:

  • Coach, manage, and develop a team of 30-100.
  • Communicate policies to your team and act as the primary information source for the team, maintaining compliance, consistency, and taking corrective action when needed.
  • Create, manage, and support recognition programs across your department.
  • Support all safety programs and OSHA compliance to ensure a safe work environment for all associates.
  • Ensure procedures are followed for building security and product loss prevention.
  • Be an integral part of our Operations team as an Area Manager of one of our largest fulfillment partners located across the country.
  • Own performance reporting for your areas of responsibility within the FC, including, but not limited to, on-time receiving and shipping, inventory accuracy, and packing quality.
  • Consistently hold yourself and your team to strict SLA expectations, providing clear and concise verbal and written reports of performance and action plans when needed.
  • Facilitate troubleshooting with relevant cross-functional parties for fulfillment-related problems.
  • Serve as an escalation point to mitigate risks and resolve issues.
  • Measure and respond to gaps in inventory accuracy, facilitating strategic initiatives to identify root causes and resolve them.
  • Review defect rates to identify trends and expose opportunities to improve operations both internally and across the network.
  • Track learnings and best practices to contribute to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Help prioritize the resolution of systemic problems, working closely with our Growth and Engineering teams.

You should have:

  • 2+ years managing staff of 5 or more.
  • Must be able to lift up to 49 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Must be willing and able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach.
  • Must be able to stand/walk for up to 10-12 hours.
  • Must be able to work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud.
  • Must be able to work in an environment where the temperature may vary between 60 and 90 degrees and will occasionally exceed 90 degrees.
  • Must be able to work on a secure mezzanine at a height of up to 40 feet (applies to buildings with mezzanines). This position requires a candidate with the proven ability to drive process improvements and the ability to keep pace with our growth while motivating others to meet challenges in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Willing and able to work any permanent shift that may include overnights and holidays. Note that there is a high chance that your shift may overlap into part of the weekend.
  • Demonstrated collaboration with internal and external business partners to deliver greater operational performance, efficiency, and quality.
  • Precise communication around external partner decisions, issues, risks, and new processes.
  • Keen ability to distinguish internal versus external problems causes to properly focus the correct resources to resolve issues quickly.
  • Exceptional prioritization skills to ensure timely resolutions that are appropriate for the severity and impact of the situation.
  • Experience leveraging problem-solving and data analysis skills to drive high judgment decisions.
  • Strong presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous, deadline-oriented work environment.
  • Ability to adapt in a rapid growth, startup environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Great attention to detail + appreciation for the complexity associated with the consistent achievement of operational tasks.
  • Personable and collaborative; strong affinity for working cross-functionally.
  • Strong computer literacy skills, including usage of Google Sheets/Excel.
  • Incredibly hardworking and willing to do what it takes for us to reach our goals.
  • Experience in warehousing, fulfillment, or transportation/logistics management.
  • Experience working with SQL, creating and running reports.

descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it.
