We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Build the solutions to help Flexport grow

The Ecosystem team’s mission is to make information exchange in global trade easy for everyone by efficiently, securely and reliably connecting the Flexport Platform with the external Global Trade Ecosystem.

The opportunity:

We are looking for a talented Solutions Consultant to join our team! In this role you will bridge the gap between Sales, Account Management, Global Operations, Solutions Engineers and Product to ensure the successful design, development, deployment, ongoing utilization and stability of the integrations you deliver for our clients. Integrating our best in class platform seamlessly with clients is a critical component of our strategy.

You will:

  • Own the end-to-end delivery for common integrations including purchase order, booking, advanced shipping notification, shipment milestone, freight invoice and more.
  • Participate in functional requirements gathering and own project requirements design, functional testing and operations impact deliverables for complex integration projects.
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate integration testing, documentation, and troubleshooting workflows.
  • Share functional insights and nuances about different freight forwarding scenarios that might impact a given customer’s integration with Flexport Ecosystem peers.
  • Collaborate with the Account Management  and Global Operations teams to review, update and socialize SOP changes for integrated customers.
  • Work closely with Solutions Engineers to create the business objects (Quotes, Bookings, Shipments, Invoices, etc..) necessary to facilitate integration testing across various functional scenarios.
  • Facilitate User Acceptance Testing across end-users including the customer and Client Solutions ensuring successful testing and approval prior to integration go-live.
  • Partner with Client Solutions in your region / time-zone to help drive successful adoption of integrated solutions, assist in triage / diagnosis of integration issues, and aggregate feedback to recommend  improvements / feature requests to applicable teams.
  • Partner with Account Executives in your region/time-zone, ensuring they have requisite support in navigating integration related requests from their customers throughout the pre-sales process.

You should have:

  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills paired with a persistent, proactive, results-oriented mindset
  • Ability to effectively drive integrations between Flexport, our customers and the ERP, TMS, WMS and / or systems they rely on.
  • Familiarity with transmission protocols (FTP, SFTP, AS2, etc.), payload / file formats (JSON, XML, delimited files, etc.)
  • Comfort using AI-assisted tools (e.g., for code/data troubleshooting, documentation, or workflow automation) to work more efficiently.
  • Work well with cross-functional teams and provide project leadership
  • Initiative and positive attitude with a desire to learn and seek answers independently
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects with organizational and time-management skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication 
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field or relevant work experience
  • 3+ years of work experience
  • Willingness to travel (up to 25%)

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with EDI X12 and EDIFACT
  • Experience working with APIs
  • Experience with data analytics, data manipulation and system integrations
  • Supply-chain, logistics, or operations experience

descriptionHtml:

Software Engineer ll: DevEx

Every engineer at Flexport ships code that moves real freight across 112 countries. The faster and safer they can do that, the faster the world's supply chains move. The PSI (Platform, Security & Infrastructure) team makes this possible: we build the paved path and tooling that hundreds of engineers around the world rely on every day to ship.

As a Software Engineer II, you'll own well-scoped projects within our developer platform, typically working with a small group of teammates. You'll talk to the engineers who use our tools, dogfood the platform, and build a solid understanding of the problems and goals behind your work. Then you'll design and ship improvements that remove friction. You'll get support and guidance from senior engineers on the team while building real ownership of your projects from start to finish.

What You'll Do

You'll own projects within, and help evolve, the developer platform that powers Flexport engineering. That means:

  • Building paved paths and self-serve tooling that make the right thing the easy thing.
  • Building and supporting CI/CD pipelines (Buildkite, GitHub Actions), build tooling (Gradle, Bazel, npm/pnpm/bun, Go and Cargo) and artifact repositories (Artifactory, ECR, GitHub).
  • Improving the backend and frontend developer experience through projects you scope and deliver.
  • Contributing to our GraphQL and gRPC ecosystem: middleware, federation and schema sharing, CLIs, codegen, servers and clients.
  • Contributing to our IAM solutions and primitives so that things are easy and secure by default.
  • Helping engineers use and understand our container orchestration (Kubernetes, ECS) and observability stack (OpenMetrics, Datadog), so they can run, understand and debug their services.
  • Gathering feedback from internal users, turning it into clear problem statements, and working with your team to prioritize what's worth building.

You Should Have

  • 2-5 years of software engineering experience, ideally including time spent on developer platforms, internal tooling, or infrastructure that other engineers depend on.
  • Full-stack curiosity: you're comfortable in a backend service and are building comfort across frontend build pipelines, Kubernetes manifests, and CI configuration.
  • Hands-on experience with some of: a CI/CD system (GitHub Actions preferred), a container orchestrator (Kubernetes preferred), build tooling (more than one language is a plus), backend-for-frontend (GraphQL preferred), service-to-service communication (gRPC preferred), metrics, or artifact storage. You don't need all of them. You should be ready to learn the rest.
  • A good grasp of problems and goals: you ask the right questions, understand who you're building for and why, and can explain how your work connects to broader team goals.
  • Care for internal users: you treat engineers as customers, gather feedback, and check whether what you shipped actually helped.
  • Ownership of your projects: you take a project from idea to production rollout, keep stakeholders informed, and raise risks early.
  • Pride in fixing what's broken: you tackle tech debt in your area and help carry out migrations, with guidance on larger or cross-team efforts.
  • Good communication: you can write a clear design doc for your project, take part in developer interviews, and keep your teammates up to date.
  • A helpful attitude: you're the person who gets people unblocked and makes their work easier.
  • Growth mindset: you seek out feedback, learn quickly, and are building toward broader scope and impact over time.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to data-driven DevX development using metrics such as DORA.
  • Experience with AWS.
  • Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) concepts such as JWTs, OIDC and fine-grained authorization.
  • Experience with Terraform.

How We Work

  • We come to the office 3 times a week to hang out, whiteboard, and ship together.
  • We have the latest hardware and software, including frontier AI models on day one.
  • We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best.

Why This Role Is Special

  • Real leverage: improvements you ship are used by hundreds of engineers and thousands of deploys a day.
  • Meaningful ownership: you own your projects end to end, from developer research to production rollout to measuring impact.
  • Room to grow: you'll work alongside senior engineers, get regular feedback, and build the skills to take on larger-scope work.

What's in it for you: 

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment.
  • Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis.
  • Commute expenses: Flexport will cover  home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam.
  • 25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.
  • Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport. 
  • A defined pension contribution scheme.
  • Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.
  • Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members.
  • Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.

Hundreds of engineers and thousands of freight operators around the world rely on Flexport's internal systems every single day to keep billions of dollars of freight moving. Keeping those systems — and the people who use them — secure is not a compliance checkbox. It's the core infrastructure for a company operating across 112 countries.

The PSI (Platform, Security & Infrastructure) team is looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own the security of Flexport's corporate environment: endpoints, identity systems, internal networks, and the SaaS estate. This is a security engineering role, not an IT support role, and not a role where you write policies and hope for the best. You'll build, automate, and be on the ground when things get real.

What You'll Do

Endpoint & SaaS security

  • Own and mature our endpoint security stack (EDR) across macOS and Windows fleets, writing device policy as code — configuration profiles, remediation scripts, and enforcement rules — with staged rollout and rollback built in.
  • Own security configuration and monitoring for Flexport's critical SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, and similar) through SSPM tooling, catching risky OAuth grants and configuration drift before they become incidents.

Access management

  • Drive Flexport's identity posture: SSO coverage, phishing-resistant MFA and passkey rollout, SCIM lifecycle automation, and least-privilege access across the SaaS and cloud estate.
  • Lead Flexport's zero-trust journey — making sure the right people have the right access, with the right controls, verified continuously.

Detection & response

  • Build and tune detection rules in our SIEM, turning signal into actionable alerts, not noise.
  • Lead incident response for security events: triage, contain, remediate, and write the retrospective.

Vulnerability & risk management

  • Run regular assessments of corporate endpoints and prioritize findings by real business risk.
  • Manage vendor and third-party security reviews, working with procurement and legal to evaluate risk before it lands in our environment.

Security enablement & leadership

  • Partner with IT, Engineering, and People teams to embed security into the way we work without creating friction that drives people to workarounds.
  • Develop and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and internal documentation that make the whole team more capable, and mentor engineers earlier in their career.
  • Bring a point of view on how agentic AI tools and browser-based AI assistants change what corporate security needs to watch for.

You Should Have

  • Typically 5–8 years of experience in enterprise security, corporate IT security, or information security engineering — we care more about what you've built than the exact number. If you meet most of this, apply.
  • Strong working knowledge of endpoint security tooling: DLP (Cyberhaven, Purview, Varonis, or similar) and EDR (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or similar).
  • Practical SIEM experience, writing detection logic, triaging alerts, and reducing false positive noise.
  • Experience leading or playing a significant role in security incident response.
  • Working knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

Nice to Have

  • Experience with network security in a cloud-first environment (ZTNA, SASE, DNS filtering).
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform) for security configuration management.
  • Familiarity with SCIM, OIDC, and fine-grained authorization at scale.
  • Experience working in a high-growth, global technology company.
  • Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or similar, for automating detection, response, and operational tasks.
  • Exposure to privacy regulations relevant to a European and global context (GDPR, etc.).

How We Work

  • We come to the office 3 times a week to hang out, whiteboard, and ship together.

Why This Role Is Special

  • Broad ownership: you're not a cog in a large security org — you own the corporate security posture end to end, from endpoints to observability to incident response.

Build the solutions to help Flexport grow

The Ecosystem team’s mission is to make information exchange in global trade easy for everyone by efficiently, securely and reliably connecting the Flexport Platform with the external Global Trade Ecosystem.

The opportunity

We are looking for a talented Integration Support Engineer to join our team! In this role you will be supporting the integrations built to help exchange data between Flexport and our customers and partners.. You will serve as an SME for customers utilizing our self-service API’s, providing technical team members with business knowledge to help us solve our customers API issues..

Integrating our best in class platform seamlessly with our logistics partners is a critical component of our strategy. Our integrated solutions bring end to end automation in the information exchange that is required between us and our partners, eliminating slow and error prone manual workflows. This requires the Flexport platform to be fully integrated with customers and any third party systems our customer uses. The success of our team is measured by the extent to which information exchange between Flexport and our customers is reliably and effectively automated, reducing cost to serve for our operations teams.

We’re looking for an organized and motivated person to ensure inbound requests are triaged quickly and efficiently, owning all communications with major stakeholders including customers, engineers and platform teams. In addition, you’ll work closely with Solutions Engineers and Solutions Consultants to identify process improvements that will maximize the efficiency of the integration support team.

You will serve as a technical anchor for our production environment. You will go beyond basic triage to lead deep-dive technical investigations, implement code or configuration enhancements, and collaborate cross-functionally to improve the scalability of our ecosystem. You are expected to manage complex stakeholder relationships and act as a subject matter expert (SME) for our integration suite.

You will

  • Proactively support the integrations running in our production environment. This would include monitoring and triaging the inbound requests, providing support for integration issues, owning investigations end to end and contributing to the integration support knowledge base. Drive end-to-end resolution for high-priority production incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent fixes or workarounds.
  • Partner with internal operations, business and technical teams to drive the success rate of these integrations to help bring maximum value to our customers. Lead meetings with customers/third parties by involving required internal team members to help resolve any issues.
  • Identify and execute improvement enhancements within the integrations or surface platform level improvements.
  • Work as a technical expert in the logistics space, EDI standards being used by our larger partners for logistics data, Boomi (our iPaaS), and Flexport public (and private) APIs and develop a deep understanding of new and existing integrations.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to transition new integrations from "build" to "support." Act as the voice of the customer to influence the product roadmap based on recurring support trends. 
  • Work efficiently to contribute to a high success rate across all support SLAs by identifying opportunities to optimize existing processes as well as product inefficiencies and also help educate our users on best practice guidelines and overall integration success guidelines
  • Lead technical calls with high-value customers and third-party vendors. You will translate complex technical EDI/API issues into actionable business insights for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Create and maintain required charts, dashboards to monitor the health of integrations
  • Ensure the team meets or exceeds SLAs, taking ownership of the most challenging tickets while identifying systemic bottlenecks in the support workflow.
  • Share insights and lessons learned about the integration issues you come across with your Flexport Ecosystem peers to continuously improve our processes and efficiency

You should have

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field and relevant work experience of minimum 3-5 years of relevant experience in systems integration, technical support, or implementation engineering.
  • Good knowledge of APIs (REST/SOAP) and EDI standards. 
  • You should be comfortable reading logs, querying databases, and understanding the flow of data through complex distributed systems.
  • Experience with data analytics, data manipulation and systems integration involving various data formats using different connectivity methods.
  • Experience with SQL and at least one scripting or programming language (e.g., JavaScript, Typescript, Python, or Groovy) or Integration platforms like Boomi, Mulesoft, Webmethods etc to assist in data manipulation or small code changes.
  • Experience using various tools to debug/monitor the transactions like postman, SQL clients, reporting tools like looker and experience working with AWS infrastructure including EC2, S3, SQS and others.
  • Experience working with AI/LLMs to debug/triage issues, generate reports etc.
  • Ability to effectively support integrations between Flexport and our customers to achieve a high success rate of these integrations. Work with various internal teams and external partners. Should have passion for helping our users excel with our integrations, offering best practice guidance when opportunities arise
  • Ability to prioritize, focus, and adhere to support SLAs and should be able to manage multiple priorities and tickets with organizational and time-management skills 
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills paired with a persistent, proactive, results-oriented mindset, excellent verbal and written communication
  • Initiative and positive attitude with a desire to learn and seek answers independently and curiosity to explore the technical side of supply chain / logistics industry

Bonus points if you have

  • Deep understanding of logistics business logic (Shipments, Orders, Invoices) and specific EDI sets (e.g., 850, 856, 214, 315).
  • iPaaS Expertise:Certified or highly experienced in Boomi (highly preferred), MuleSoft, or Workato.

The Customs team works with clients, shippers, and other freight companies to collect and file the necessary documentation required by different governments to import goods. Internally, the Customs team works closely with our technology partners to drive innovation through process automation. This product is positioned for more than 10x growth in the coming five years. 

This is a great opportunity for someone with at least 1 year of Customs experience to join the broker of the future. As part of our team, you'll leverage state-of-the-art technology to streamline and automate customs processes, setting new standards in the industry. You’ll be working alongside industry leaders and experts in a vibrant, intellectually stimulating environment that thrives on innovation and teamwork to drive global trade. We invest in our people and provide continuous learning opportunities to help you advance in your career and become a thought leader in the customs brokerage field. Be part of Flexport, where your contributions as a Customs Broker will not only redefine the trade landscape and help us build the future of global trade!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Navigate the complex landscape of customs regulations and ensure that all goods comply with international protocols and legal requirements
  • Obtain necessary documents and provide complete and accurate information to CBP to facilitate smooth customs clearance
  • Collaborate with international clients and logistics partners to provide them with timely and accurate customs advice and support
  • Optimize customs processes using Flexport's proprietary technology, providing insights and data-driven recommendations to our clients
  • You will be responsible for ensuring your work satisfies internal key performance indicators that demonstrate quality and timeliness.
  • Follow standard operating procedures (SOP) and improve processes as needed
  • Participate in business reviews on a regular cadence including presentation prep as well as hold client operational calls when deemed necessary

Qualifications: 

  • At least 1 year experience as a Customs Entry Writer
  • Familiarity with U.S. Customs regulations, classifications, and rulings
  • A "compliance-first" mindset, with a commitment to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and regulatory adherence
  • Works independently with minimal supervision
  • Works under fluctuating pressure and tight deadlines
  • Adapt to new technology and can thrive in a fast paced environment
  • Effective time management. Be able to properly prioritize and manage a large volume of tasks
  • High attention to detail
  • Effectively seek and receive feedback
  • Effective communication both verbally and in writing
  • Orientation towards working smarter and adopting best practices and standardization
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities

As Flexport continues to grow its footprint across Asia Pacific, we're looking for a Payroll Manager to be the cornerstone of payroll excellence across the region. You'll own the full payroll cycle for our APAC entities — spanning Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, Greater China, Vietnam, Thailand, Korea, Japan, Indonesia, Cambodia, Philippines, India and other new markets as we expand — and serve as the go-to expert where precision, compliance, and people experience intersect.

Sitting within the APAC People team and reporting to the Senior Director, People APAC, this is a people-manager role leading a team of one, with significant cross-functional visibility. You'll set the regional payroll operating standard, drive payroll strategy, build out your team as scale demands, and work closely with Finance, People Operations, and business partners to ensure every employee across APAC is paid accurately and on time.

What You'll Do

- Own Regional Payroll End to End: Lead monthly payroll processing across 18+ APAC entities, managing vendor relationships and ensuring timely, accurate execution at scale.

- Handle Direct Payroll Execution: Perform hands-on processing and verification for assigned entities, directly coordinating with payroll vendors to calculate and finalize local payroll runs.

- Lead & Develop the Team: Manage and grow a direct report responsible for payroll data preparation — set priorities, review quality, and build a team structure that scales with new-market growth.

- Drive Data Accuracy: Coordinate with Finance on payment funding, GL booking, cost centre allocation, and month-end reconciliations — keeping payroll and finance in lockstep.

- Support the Full Employee Lifecycle: Own off-cycle payments, bonus runs, and statutory pay calculations across all employment events, ensuring compliance with local labour requirements.

- Enable Compliant Growth: Partner with the Expansion team to onboard new APAC entities onto payroll — from vendor setup to first run — as Flexport enters new markets.

- Support on regional bonus scheme: partner with global and regional stakeholders on incentive plan.

- Be the Audit & Compliance Expert: Own external audit requests, maintain payroll documentation standards, and manage compliance notifications as the business evolves.

- Elevate Vendor Performance: Own vendor SLA performance across a large multi-vendor footprint, proactively resolving service issues and driving consistent quality across all markets.

- Own Leave & Statutory Pay Calculations: Calculate maternity, paternity, sick, and other statutory leave pay amounts across all APAC entities, coordinating with People Ops on eligibility determination.

- Manage Overtime Compliance: Ensure accurate, compliant overtime calculations across markets with strict statutory multiplier requirements.

- Administer Post-Employment Payments: Process ongoing non-compete payments and other post-termination obligations, tracking start and stop dates for accuracy.

- Execute Compensation Changes: Process merit increases and promotions once approved, including any required backpay adjustments, accurately and on schedule.

- Lead Annual Compliance Cycles: Own annual individual income tax reconciliation and social insurance/housing fund base adjustments across applicable markets.

- Manage Equity-Related Withholding: Handle tax withholding and reporting obligations triggered by RSU vesting events across jurisdictions.

What We're Looking For

- 8+ years of hands-on APAC payroll experience, including 3+ years managing/leading a team, and demonstrated ownership of 5+ countries' payroll operations at scale (ideally 10+).

- Broad multi-country payroll experience across the region — Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, Greater China, Vietnam, Thailand, Korea, Japan, Indonesia, Cambodia, Philippines, India — with a track record of standing up new-market payroll from scratch.

- Deep knowledge of statutory compliance, local labour laws, and payroll vendor management across a large, diverse APAC footprint.

- Proven people-management experience — able to coach, delegate, and build capability in a small but scaling team.

- Hands-on experience using modern AI assistants to automate data analysis, reporting, and modelling.

- Proven ability to partner with Finance on reconciliations, GL allocations, and audit deliverables.

- A reputation for precision — you hold yourself and your team to a high bar and catch issues before they reach employees.

- Strong communicator who can work fluidly across Finance, People Operations, and People Business Partners.

- Experience with HRIS platforms, specifically Workday.

- Professional proficiency in English is a MUST.

- Energised by a fast-scaling environment and excited to build payroll infrastructure and a team from the ground up in new markets.

- Comfortable challenging ideas and holding space for other perspectives to be heard.

- Strong logical approach to resolving complex issues and adept at fostering resilience.

- Committed to maintaining a high degree of personal integrity and confidentiality.

descriptionHtml:
About Flexport:

Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an Accounts Receivable Collections Analyst who wants to use AI and agents to help customers pay on time. You’ll manage a portfolio of customer accounts, using AI to prioritize outreach, investigate overdue balances, and move payment issues toward resolution. You’ll combine these tools with clear communication and strong relationships with customers’ Accounts Payable teams.

This role is open to people starting their careers or moving into finance. Curiosity, persistence, and good judgment matter more than a traditional collections background. You’ll help shape how our team works with AI, learning our accounts receivable processes as you go. The role reports to the Head of North American Collections.

You Will

  • Use AI tools and agents to prioritize assigned accounts, draft personalized email follow-ups, and track payment commitments. Pair these workflows with phone outreach and customer conversations to help meet cash collection and days sales outstanding (DSO) targets.
  • Use AI to review account aging and summarize collection activity. Check the results and keep records of customer conversations, payment promises, disputes, and next steps accurate and up to date.
  • Build relationships with customers’ Accounts Payable teams and act as their point of contact for collections and payment questions.
  • Coordinate incoming requests and handle initial escalations. Resolve issues promptly and bring in the right team when a problem needs further review.
  • Investigate account balances with support from AI tools and teammates. Check the underlying invoices and payment history, recommend next steps, and ask for help when an issue needs deeper review.
  • Research invoice and payment discrepancies, reconcile account information, and work with the appropriate teams to resolve customers’ AR/AP questions.
  • Work with Credit to arrange and monitor approved payment schedules for overdue accounts.
  • Prepare clear account summaries with AI support and participate in biweekly reviews with business leaders on open receivables, collection risks, and next steps.
  • Work with Credit, Account Management, Sales, Disputes, and Legal to resolve issues that delay payment while maintaining professional customer relationships.
  • Help build, test, and improve AI agents and automated workflows with the AR manager to summarize account histories, coordinate follow-ups, and flag stalled payments. Use approved tools, verify amounts and claims, protect customer information, and bring exceptions or payment decisions to the right person.
  • Support Finance and Accounting with month-end close activities, accurate account records, and other projects as needed.

Success in Your First Year

  • Your assigned accounts have clear action plans, reliable records, and consistent follow-up.
  • Collection performance improves against agreed targets, with overdue balances and disputes addressed promptly.
  • Customers and internal partners receive clear answers and dependable service.
  • You help put AI agents and workflow improvements into daily use, reducing manual work and improving follow-up speed while maintaining accuracy and financial controls.

You Should Have

  • Curiosity, initiative, and follow-through, demonstrated through work, school, volunteering, or personal projects. No specific degree or prior collections experience is required.
  • The ability to learn unfamiliar processes and systems quickly, ask thoughtful questions, and apply feedback.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, attention to detail, and the judgment to handle sensitive conversations professionally.
  • Persistence and initiative: you follow up, find practical ways to resolve issues, and take responsibility for results.
  • The ability to work independently and with others, manage competing priorities, and stay organized as workloads change.
  • An interest in using AI to solve practical problems and a willingness to experiment with tools and agents. Examples from school, personal projects, or work are welcome; professional AI experience and coding skills are not required.
  • Strong problem-solving skills: you can investigate a discrepancy, identify what is missing, and follow the issue through resolution.
  • Sound judgment about AI output and confidential data. You verify facts and figures, recognize when an answer is unreliable, and know when to seek human review.
  • Comfort working with numbers and spreadsheets. You can organize information, spot inconsistencies, and learn the Excel or Google Sheets tools needed to investigate account balances.
  • Experience in collections, finance, or customer service, or with NetSuite, Tesorio, Stripe, or automation tools, is helpful but optional. A willingness to learn matters more than familiarity with a particular system.

The People Team at Flexport is a strategic partner in driving business success through our most important asset - our people. Guided by our values, we empower our internal clients, build for the long term, act with an entrepreneurial spirit, and simplify complexity to create scalable, high-impact solutions. Above all, we win as a team—collaborating across the organization to help everyone grow and perform at their best.

The Opportunity:

We're seeking a People Business Partner to provide comprehensive HR support across our growing region. This isn't just about maintaining; it's about building and refining HR processes that empower our rapidly expanding workforce. Your focus: answering manager requests quickly and accurately, and guiding them through employee lifecycle events, working within established SOPs. You'll be responsible for a wide spectrum of HR functions like employee relations, compliance, and performance management. You‘ll be a seasoned, confident partner to your leaders: someone who knows what needs attention now, what can be handled quickly, and how to balance efficiency with building lasting relationships.

  • Day-to-day manager support and Employee Lifecycle: Be the first point of contact for manager requests. Guide leaders through onboarding, internal mobility, absence management and offboarding, following our SOPs. Keep processes swift and transparent, and continuously review and improve them.
  • Ensure Compliance: Apply local labor law in day-to-day cases in the countries we operate in, thus minimizing legal risks and ensuring regulatory compliance. Work in partnership with the legal department as necessary and proactively address any potential legal or compliance risks in accordance with the latest changes in labor laws and regulations. 
  • Performance Management: Provide managers with essential guidance on handling performance-related matters and support the review cycles. Oversee the performance appraisal process to ensure its effectiveness.
  • Employee Relations: Act as a trusted point of contact for employees and management regarding employee relations matters. Manage employee relations issues and develop relationships with leaders, employees and peers across the offices to facilitate and promote an environment that attracts and retains diverse talent
  • Policy Guidance: Assist in ensuring the application of company policies and procedures align with local needs, labor laws and regulations, reflect best practices, and support organizational goals. While the role isn't policy enforcement-centric, you'll occasionally work with the HR leadership team to provide guidance on policy matters when necessary.
  • Projects: Support recurring projects such as the twice-yearly review cycle, ad hoc requests and legal change implementation.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of HR experience in a hands-on, operational role, ideally across multiple countries
  • Deep understanding of labor law in the Netherlands and the UK. Additional EU countries are a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and a natural affinity for processes and SOPs
  • Hands-on and resilient: able to prioritise and stay decisive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Exceptional people skills: handle sensitive matters with tact, and be confident enough to push back constructively
  • Proficiency in HRIS (Workday or similar) and other HR technologies 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills

What you can expect in return:

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a thriving multinational environment and expanding region
  • Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis
  • Commute expenses: Flexport will cover home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam
  • 25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.
  • Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport.
  • A defined pension contribution scheme
  • Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.
  • Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members
  • Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The opportunity:

The role of the Ops Associate is a critical part of making Flexport’s mission to make global trade easy for everyone a reality. In this role, your direct customers are the partners within your region: our account management and customs teams, subcontractors, carriers, terminals and trucking providers. Your work directly supports Flexport’s end customers in achieving their logistics goals. Most importantly, you will play a pivotal role in building the next operational model at Flexport: allowing us to effectively scale to achieve our mission of making global trade easier for everyone.

This role is designed to problem solve impactful operational challenges as part of our Global team while developing specialized expertise in supply chain operations. As the person who executes service delivery for our clients, you have the unique opportunity to help your regional account team spot opportunities to improve and grow our customers’ business. You will be charged with helping Flexport account management teams and clients solve exceptional challenges in order to move their shipments in less time with lower costs and via improved productivity by your team, unblocking issues and establishing procedures to prevent them in the future.

Tactical Responsibilities:

As a supply chain operator, you are an expert in executing the end-to-end movement of shipments within a regional network including Ocean LCL imports and exports.

  • You will personally represent Flexport’s value proposition by leading business implementation and shipment execution for new clients and opportunities.
  • You will gain specialist expertise within a mode or function and act as the first point of escalation for issue resolution (reactive) or program improvements (proactive, both internally and externally).
  • You will be the “front line” in ensuring the highest standard of Flexport quality: shipments move “on time” and exceptions are handled appropriately. You will be responsible for ensuring your work satisfies internal KPIs and SLAs that demonstrate quality delivery.
  • You will implement and test scalable operational infrastructure and procedures to ensure they are delivering the highest levels of efficiency and productivity for your customers. If they are not, you will look for opportunities to improve them.
  • In Ocean LCL teams you will:
    • Seamlessly coordinate the day-to-day supply operations with LCL, Transload, Trucking, and Warehouse activities within your region.
    • Analyze data to rate subcontractor performance. Your analysis will inform subcontractor/carrier performance management initiatives.
    • Execute booking and documentation processes with carriers.
    • Timely shipment troubleshooting and exception escalation/handling.
    • Contribute to the development and implementation of the procedure and system to differentiate Flexport operations from the industry.

Adaptive Responsibilities:

  • You will help build and implement operational infrastructure and procedures in the day-to-day workflow, while constantly identifying and executing opportunities to realize optimal efficiency and productivity.
  • You will empower Account Management by participating in feedback loops to ensure client needs are met.
  • You will use metrics to spot opportunities to improve and deliver great performance in your role, including data quality and shipment milestone timeliness.
  • You will act as a consultant to your regional team, product & engineering and the operations excellence team on ocean supply chain operations.

Scope of Duties:

  • Execute booking and documentation processes with clients /carriers
  • Timely shipment troubleshooting and exception escalation / handling
  • Work intimately with Flexport AM, Planning team to ensure an effective end to end export process.
  • Coach junior specialists on the daily job. 
  • Plan and execute special freight operations (i.e. DG, reefer, etc). 
  • Assist Sr. Associate on new business/process implementation, new projects and new tasks. 
  • Support internal and external clients to make the best decision with your expertise;
  • Live and act with integrity guided by the company values including sustaining a high bar for operational quality and service.
  • Inform the business process and software capability needs to help scale our growing team while improving quality, service, efficiency and regulatory compliance.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of the procedure and system to differentiate Flexport operations from the industry.

What you will need: 

Experience:

  • BA/BS degree 
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain, ocean carrier operations, or consulting (ocean freight knowledge is a plus) 

Mindset:
Desire to “build a better machine” and get irritated when things aren’t optimal

  • Hands-on, process-oriented, structured thinking with strong problem-solving capabilities 
  • Strategic vision and ground floor execution
  • Excitement to manage vendor relations and create best-in-class, innovative structures to do so
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills
  • A client service mindset; you are obsessed with client and squad happiness
  • Next-level attention to detail
  • Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it!
  • Flexibility to get the job done when needed. Willing to work outside office hours and occasional weekend or night shifts in certain locations.

What you will learn: 

  • You will learn what it takes to lead small teams in the execution of day-to-day tactical tasks.
  • You will learn how to thrive in an ambiguous environment, research and test operational hypotheses and inform the strategy of a newly built team.
  • You will gain specialist expertise to become an ocean or network operations and intermodal subject matter expert within the company. You are the leading advisor in this area, someone our clients, partners, and internal teams go to for advice and strategy.
  • You will gain the ability to continuously improve the client experience through a deep industry understanding. You are singularly positioned to realize how we can both work within and push the logistics industry forward to meet the standards of Flexport’s client-centric service.

descriptionHtml:
About Flexport:

We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The opportunity:

You just graduated and you know you want a commercial career, but you're not sure which lane yet. Sales? Account management? Something else?

12 months inside Flexport's commercial engine. Four rotations, four mentors, one goal: find where you fit.

  • Months 1–3: Open doors as an SDR
  • Months 4–6: Manage clients as an Account Manager
  • Months 7–9: Close deals alongside a top salesperson
  • Months 10–12: Go deep in Operations, Marketing, or Customs — your pick

You'll have a named 1:1 mentor each block, plus one programme-wide buddy who stays with you the entire year. You'll also build with low-code tools alongside our engineering team. Global trade runs on tech now, not just relationships. 

The payoff: after a successful completion of the program you will get a permanent Account Executive, Business Development Rep, or Account Manager role by month 12, plus a company-wide network most new hires take years to build.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Block 1 – Sales Development: generate pipeline through outbound outreach, qualify leads, and keep Salesforce updated.
Block 2 – Account Management: support client meetings, identify upsell/renewal opportunities, and learn the customer lifecycle.
Block 3 – Sales: support a full sales cycle from discovery to close, including deal structuring and negotiation.
Block 4 – Elective: complete a project in Operations, Marketing, or Customs of your choice.

Alongside all four blocks, you'll also join Engineering sessions every two weeks, learn low-code/no-code tools, and build your own capstone project by year-end.

Is this you?
• A recent graduate (Bachelor's or Master's) — any discipline
• Fluent in German and English
• Willing to relocate to Hamburg or Frankfurt
• Strong affinity with commercial roles but unsure which exact direction
• Comfortable learning new tools and systems
• No sales experience required
• Solution-oriented, self-motivated, detail-oriented and organised

Please note that fluency in both German and English is required. We kindly ask our candidates to apply with a CV in English! :-) 

What's in there for you: 

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment
  • Lunch food delivery 4 days a week incl. vegetarian options, a salad bar and special menu options, plus breakfast options, snacks, soft drinks and barista coffee.
  • Health insurance:  employee contribution part is covered by Flexport
  • 25 paid vacation days
  • Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.
  • Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members
  • Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.

title: Software Engineer II, Autonomous Freight Technology
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The Opportunity

Join our engineering team in Bellevue building and enhancing Flexport’s client-facing rates platform and self-serve freight booking experience. You will work alongside experienced engineers and have direct ownership of features that move the company from an assisted-sales model to a tech-run one for the long tail of our client base.

This team owns two of the highest-leverage surfaces in the Client App: how clients see pricing and how they book without manual intervention. Rates sit at the center of every freight decision, and you will build the systems that power rate visibility, quoting, and pricing intelligence across our ocean business. You will also help build the infrastructure that integrates AI-powered automation into the booking flow. This is a rare opportunity to build the "front door" of an $8.6 trillion industry, turning the complexity of global trade into a seamless digital experience for thousands of shippers.

You Will

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain systems within a microservices architecture that power rate visibility and autonomous booking.
  • Own the entire lifecycle of a feature: from database schema design and scalable backend APIs to building the React-based frontend applications our customers use.
  • Support the integration of AI models and automated workflows to make the pricing and booking experience increasingly intelligent.
  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and design to translate complex business problems into elegant, production-ready technical solutions.
  • Contribute to code reviews to maintain high quality standards, share knowledge, and mentor peer engineers.
  • Build highly available, secure, and distributed systems that can scale with Flexport’s global volume.
  • Rapidly build and launch products incrementally, leveraging best practices around CI/CD and shipping to production dozens of times per day.
  • Ensure high-quality standards by incorporating metrics, monitoring, and applying learnings from post-mortems to all services.

You Should Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience with a proven track record of shipping production-grade applications.
  • Full-Stack Capability: You are comfortable owning a feature from end-to-end: working with databases, backend services (Java/Ruby), and frontend frameworks (React).
  • Technical Rigor: A passion for simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.
  • AI Familiarity: Experience or interest in working with AI APIs and building software that leverages machine learning models to automate user tasks.
  • 2+ years of design and architecture knowledge as well as familiarity with object-oriented analysis and design patterns.
  • Proficiency with modern programming languages: specifically Java, Ruby, or TypeScript.
  • Proficiency with deploying, monitoring, and maintaining production services on cloud infrastructure (AWS).

It’s a Plus If You Have

  • Experience with elements of our tech stack: Java, Spring Boot, Ruby on Rails, React, AWS.
  • Experience in fintech, pricing engines, or booking systems.
  • Experience in logistics, supply chain, or freight technology.
  • A bias for action: When you see a problem, you fix it.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills: you can convey technical ideas in common terms to business stakeholders and product managers.

The opportunity: 

Flexport continues to experience significant growth as a technology platform for international trade. One of the company's core products is Customs which is working on behalf of clients to facilitate the import of goods across international borders. The process includes classifying the imported items, calculating duties, and transmitting this information to the US government. The Customs team works with clients, shippers, and other freight companies to collect and file the necessary documentation required by different governments to import goods. Internally, the Customs team works closely with our technology partners to drive innovation through process automation. This product is positioned for more than 10x growth in the coming five years. 

This is a great opportunity for someone with at least 1 year of Customs experience to join the broker of the future. As part of our team, you'll leverage state-of-the-art technology to streamline and automate customs processes, setting new standards in the industry. You’ll be working alongside industry leaders and experts in a vibrant, intellectually stimulating environment that thrives on innovation and teamwork to drive global trade. We invest in our people and provide continuous learning opportunities to help you advance in your career and become a thought leader in the customs brokerage field. Be part of Flexport, where your contributions as a Customs Broker will not only redefine the trade landscape and help us build the future of global trade!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Navigate the complex landscape of customs regulations and ensure that all goods comply with international protocols and legal requirements
  • Obtain necessary documents and provide complete and accurate information to CBP to facilitate smooth customs clearance
  • Collaborate with international clients and logistics partners to provide them with timely and accurate customs advice and support
  • Optimize customs processes using Flexport's proprietary technology, providing insights and data-driven recommendations to our clients
  • You will be responsible for ensuring your work satisfies internal key performance indicators that demonstrate quality and timeliness.
  • Follow standard operating procedures (SOP) and improve processes as needed
  • Participate in business reviews on a regular cadence including presentation prep as well as hold client operational calls when deemed necessary

  • Familiarity with U.S. Customs regulations, classifications, and rulings

  • Works independently with minimal supervision
  • Works under fluctuating pressure and tight deadlines
  • Adapt to new technology and can thrive in a fast paced environment
  • Effective time management. Be able to properly prioritize and manage a large volume of tasks
  • High attention to detail
  • Effectively seek and receive feedback
  • Effective communication both verbally and in writing
  • Orientation towards working smarter and adopting best practices and standardization
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, or a related field a plus

The opportunity:

Join Flexport's dynamic Compliance Program as the Senior Manager, Supply Chain Protection & Loss Intelligence. This critical role serves as the single point of accountability for both supply chain protection and loss prevention across Flexport's entire footprint — offices, fulfillment centers, and partner sites worldwide. The Manager will be responsible for protecting Flexport employees, visitors, assets, and facilities through the design and execution of security programs, while simultaneously driving a proactive loss prevention strategy across the Omni fulfillment network.

Day-to-day, this means managing a team of 50+ contracted security officers across multiple locations, overseeing electronic security infrastructure (CCTV, access control), conducting investigations, and managing the security ticketing system. Strategically, it means building the analytical foundation to identify loss trends and security gaps before they become incidents, authoring the policies and SOPs that standardize how Flexport protects its people and assets globally, and ensuring every new facility launches with security infrastructure and protocols in place from day one. 

You will partner closely with operations, facilities, and leadership to design, implement, and scale security programs for existing and future locations, ensuring our people, assets, and reputation are safeguarded as Flexport rapidly expands into new markets. This is a unique opportunity to build a unified security strategy, moving beyond reactive incident management to a data-driven, proactive approach.

You will:

  • Develop and maintain security and loss prevention metrics, KPIs, and dashboards to measure program effectiveness across all facilities and regions
  • Analyze incident data to identify trends, loss patterns, root causes, and emerging risks — translating findings into actionable recommendations for leadership
  • Build reporting frameworks that support data-driven resource allocation, vendor performance evaluation, and security investment decisions
  • Provide regular analytical reports to senior management on security posture, loss prevention outcomes, and program ROI
  • Author, maintain, and enforce global security and loss prevention policies, ensuring consistency across all Flexport locations and compliance with local regulatory requirements in each jurisdiction
  • Develop and implement SOPs for key security scenarios (Active Shooter, Emergency Response, High Value Cage procedures, Product Disposal, etc.)
  • Create site-level security plans for new and existing facilities, tailored to local risk profiles and operational requirements
  • Design and deliver training programs across physical security and loss prevention topics (emergency response, office security, travel security, incident reporting, etc.)
  • Develop audit frameworks and LP checklists for site leads to execute on a recurring basis
  • Manage physical security programs across all Flexport facilities globally (offices, warehouses, and partner sites), including new locations as Flexport and the Omni fulfillment network expand into new markets
  • Lead security planning and infrastructure stand-up for new facilities and market entries, including site assessments, vendor selection, and system deployment
  • Administer and maintain electronic security systems, including CCTV surveillance and access control platforms, and evaluate new technology deployments
  • Serve as the crisis management coordinator, providing real-time threat assessments and coordinating emergency response across regions
  • Coordinate with HSE, HR, Legal, and Compliance on cross-functional security and safety matters
  • Drive loss prevention strategy and investigations for the Omni fulfillment network, including cargo theft, employee theft, unauthorized sellers, workplace violence, and empty package findings
  • Manage the security and loss prevention ticketing syste, including triaging, updating, and resolving tickets with accurate documentation
  • Identify root causes of supply chain losses and develop recommendations to reduce future risk
  • Review, collect, and preserve CCTV evidence to support investigations and legal proceedings
  • Manage third-party guard services across all locations, including oversight of 50+ security officers, performance tracking, and operational discipline
  • Manage relationships with security integrators and onboard new vendors as required for geographic expansion
  • Oversee vendor contracts, MSAs, and NDAs for all security-related service providers
  • Conduct regular business reviews with key vendors and evaluate service delivery against contractual obligations

You should have:

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in a rike that combined physical security or loss prevention responsibilities with data analytics, policy development, or program design. Traditional security experience alone is not sufficient — this role requires a candidate who has built metrics programs, authored policies, or used data to drive security strategy.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage security operations across multiple locations and geographies, including hands-on experience with electronic security systems (CCTV, access control platforms).
  • Demonstrated experience building and analyzing security and loss prevention metrics, with comfort working in data platforms and translating incident data into actionable insights and executive-level reporting
  • Proven ability to author global policies, SOPs, security plans, and program documentation from scratch.
  • Experience managing third-party guard services and security vendor contracts, as well as conducting complex investigations (theft, workplace violence, supply chain security).
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams including HR, Legal, Operations, and Compliance
  • An analytical mindset with attention to detail and the ability to identify root causes and solve problems
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed

You will get:

descriptionHtml:

Position Overview

The Regional Air Freight Manager owns and leads all aspects of air freight performance, strategy, and business growth across assigned trade lanes and geographic territories (e.g., SouthCentral, Mountain and SouthWest/SoCal or designated regional trade lanes). This multi-dimensional role carries end-to-end financial accountability, down to Contribution Profit, while leading regional capacity procurement, bespoke door-to-door solution design, and go-to-market (GTM) commercial execution.

Serving as a key pillar of regional leadership, this role bridges global air freight strategy with local operational execution. You will act as a collaborative partner across cross-functional organizations (including Sales, Account Management, Global Procurement, Operations, Tech, and Finance) to expand market share, build strategic airline partnerships, and ensure flawless customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Leadership & P&L Ownership

  • Strategic Planning & Target Setting: Define and execute the region’s long-term air freight vision, program initiatives, focus lanes, and growth objectives in close alignment with Global Air strategy and regional leadership (GM).
  • P&L & Financial Accountability: Own full financial performance (including Tonnage/Volume, Net Revenue, and Contribution Profit, e.g. Net Revenue minus Direct Costs) for assigned regional origin/destination combinations and trade lanes.
  • Performance Governance & Metrics: Co-define annual budgets with General Management and actively participate in weekly business reviews (WBRs) to report on key metrics, yield performance, target adherence, and shortfall mitigation plans.
  • Continuous Process Improvement: Drive operational efficiency and take-rate expansion by identifying structural bottlenecks, grounding decisions in rigorous data analysis, and driving initiatives to "build a better machine."

2. Capacity Procurement, Pricing & Solution Design

  • Export & Import Solutioning: Fully own end-to-end export procurement, routing, and solution design for the region. Partner with overseas/origin air procurement managers to secure competitive import capacity, transit times, and door-to-door pricing tailored to client requirements.
  • Airline Relationship & Vendor Management: Nurture and leverage executive-level relationships with regional and global airline carriers. Assess carrier performance, enforce service level agreements (SLAs), drive service quality improvements, and coordinate regional air trucking/drayage coverage.
  • RFQ Sponsorship & Bid Management: Oversee custom door-to-door pricing structures for regional bids. Act as the executive sponsor for high-value global RFQs for top regional accounts, ensuring sharp, market-competitive solutions that protect margins.
  • Contract Administration & Compliance: Own and manage carrier agreements, block space agreements (BSAs), and spot rates within the internal procurement database to guarantee accurate cost application and rate compliance across systems.

3. Business Development & Commercial Enablement

  • Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy: Serve as the default subject-matter expert for regional demand teams. Shape commercial strategies by identifying high-potential target verticals, providing qualified prospect lead lists, and guiding initial outreach.
  • Client Acquisition & Executive Selling: Actively participate in regional commercial operating rhythms (pipeline reviews, top-of-funnel reviews, district sales meetings). Accompany sales teams on client visits, lead strategic pitch presentations, and help close complex enterprise deals.
  • Account Retention & Expansion: Partner with Account Management to expand wallet share with existing clients through creative pricing, customized air charter/freight solutions, and proactive relationship management to prevent churn.
  • Market Intelligence & Communication: Continuously monitor air cargo market dynamics, rate fluctuations, capacity constraints, and competitor positioning. Regularly communicate actionable market insights to local and regional sales organizations.

4. Operational Excellence & Local Culture

  • Apprenticeship & Mentorship: Serve as a cultural pillar by coaching, training, and mentoring local teams across Operations, Customer Service, and Pricing to build deep regional expertise.
  • Hands-on Operational Escalation: Utilize deep first-hand operational knowledge to step in when needed (troubleshooting quality issues, resolving execution breakdowns, and demonstrating end-to-end shipment handling best practices.)
  • Internal & External Representation: Represent the Global Air Team in regional executive meetings and represent the company externally at industry conferences, vendor summits, and customer events.

Candidate Qualifications & Requirements

Experience

  • Industry Experience: 7+ years of experience at a freight forwarder or in a similar field
  • Solutioning & Pricing Expertise: 5+ years of direct experience designing complex, door-to-door air freight routing solutions and competitive pricing models for enterprise customers of varying sizes.
  • Commercial & Executive Engagement: Proven track record in business development, senior-level client relationship management, and winning strategic RFQs.
  • Network & Industry Rolodex: Established relationships with regional and global airline leadership, as well as an active client network within the region (highly preferred).

Skills & Competencies

  • Financial & Analytical Acumen: Deep understanding of freight forwarding economics, P&L management, yield optimization, and data-driven decision-making.
  • End-to-End Operational Knowledge: Direct, practical knowledge of air freight operations, TSA/security regulations, cross-border customs, carrier routings, and local drayage workflows.
  • High Energy & Collaboration: Proactive, highly energetic leader capable of operating seamlessly across time zones, from coordinating with overseas procurement teams at night to negotiating with local vendors and clients during the day.
  • Communication & Negotiation: Superior verbal, written, and presentation skills with a strong ability to influence internal stakeholders and external executive decision-makers.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Economics, or equivalent practical industry experience.

As Flexport scales its Accounts Payable operations, we are looking for a Manager, Accounts Payable based in Vietnam to lead a team of AP Associates supporting invoice processing, freight auditing, and account reconciliation. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Accounts Payable & Freight Audit, this is a hands-on leadership role that blends people management, process ownership, and technical fluency in automation and AI-driven process design. The ideal candidate combines strong AP and freight audit expertise with the ability to build practical automation solutions directly, while identifying and escalating opportunities for broader AI-enabled improvements across the function.

What You’ll Do

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop a team of 10–12 AP Associates across invoice processing, freight audit, and account reconciliation functions, ensuring consistent performance management, coaching, and a collaborative team culture
  • Partner with the Senior Manager, Accounts Payable & Freight Audit, and cross-functional stakeholders to align on priorities, process improvements, and resourcing needs

Operational Excellence

  • Oversee the accuracy and timeliness of high-volume invoice processing, freight invoice auditing, and account reconciliation across the team
  • Review and resolve complex or escalated billing disputes, discrepancies, and reconciliation variances, partnering with carriers, vendors, and internal stakeholders as needed
  • Ensure adherence to company policies, contractual terms, and regulatory requirements across all processing, freight audit, and reconciliation activities
  • Maintain working knowledge of multi-country tax, invoicing, and regulatory requirements relevant to the team’s expanding scope, ensuring operations remain compliant as responsibilities grow

Automation & Continuous Improvement

Build and deploy practical automation tools and AI-enabled workflows directly, while identifying and escalating additional opportunities that improve AP automation, operating efficiency, and scalabilityAnalyse and report on team performance and the impact of process or automation changes, recommending continuous improvements with a focus on accuracy, efficiency, and execution speed

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in Accounts Payable, freight auditing, or related finance operations, including experience managing or developing a team
  • Hands-on experience with AP systems, ERP platforms (e.g. NetSuite), and freight audit tools
  • Experience building or implementing automation tools or AI-enabled workflows, with the ability to identify further opportunities for improvement
  • Strong understanding of invoice matching, freight rate structures, account reconciliation processes, and accessorial charges
  • Working knowledge of multi-country tax, invoicing, and regulatory requirements, with the ability to apply this knowledge as the team’s scope expands beyond Vietnam
  • Strong knowledge of financial controls, compliance frameworks, and audit metrics

  • Develop and maintain technical operating procedures, policies, and engineering roadmaps.
  • Work closely with the Security team to ensure the platform is designed and implemented with security best practices.
  • Provide Tier 3 IT support.

You Should Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field (or comparable experience).
  • 3+ years of experience in supporting SaaS Collaboration tools, Mac and Windows endpoint management.
  • Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
  • In-depth knowledge of email delivery flow, IT security, and IAM concepts.
  • Understanding of RBAC and permissions models across core SaaS applications.

title: Senior Product Manager, Fulfillment
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Product Manager on Flexport's Warehouse Management System (WMS), you will own the software that runs work inside the warehouses fulfilling orders for Flexport merchants. You will set the product vision for your area of a modern, scalable WMS and partner with engineering, design, warehouse operations, and business teams to ship it. Your work shapes how fast, accurate, and cost-efficient fulfillment is for merchants of every size.

Omnichannel Fulfillment at Flexport

Omnichannel fulfillment sits at the heart of Flexport's mission to make global commerce so easy that there would be more of it. By integrating logistics across e-commerce, retail, and direct-to-consumer channels, we help merchants deliver faster, more efficiently, and at lower cost. The WMS is the execution layer underneath all of it: it turns merchant orders and inventory into physical work on the warehouse floor. Learn more about Flexport Omnichannel here.

What You'll Do

  • Lead product strategy for your WMS area: Define the vision, goals, and roadmap for the warehouse execution capabilities you own, in line with the broader WMS and Omnichannel strategy.
  • Own the product lifecycle: Drive features from discovery and BRDs through launch and iteration, tying each to merchant and business outcomes.
  • Drive platform evolution: Contribute to the migration and consolidation of warehouse systems onto Flexport's WMS, including regression testing, cutover planning, and risk management with warehouse partners.
  • Partner with warehouse operations: Work with operations and site teams to turn floor-level workflows, constraints, and exceptions into scalable product capabilities.
  • Partner cross-functionally: Align engineering, design, data science, and adjacent product teams (inventory, inbounds, outbounds, returns, merchant APIs and reporting) on priorities and integration points.
  • Champion customer and operator insight: Gather feedback from merchants, warehouse associates, and operations leaders to guide prioritization.
  • Communicate with leadership: Report progress, trade-offs, and risks to senior leaders across Flexport and key customers.
  • Measure and iterate: Define and track metrics for your area, such as cycle time, accuracy, throughput, and cost per order.
  • Mentor: Coach junior product managers and raise the bar for product craft on the team.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of launching and scaling complex, high-impact products.
  • Hands-on experience with WMS, fulfillment, or supply chain execution systems, and a working grasp of warehouse workflows such as receiving, putaway, picking, packing, and inventory control.
  • Experience leading large system migrations or platform replacements, from planning and testing through cutover.
  • Demonstrated leadership of cross-functional teams, including engineering and operations, delivering complex projects from concept to execution.
  • Strong prioritization and the ability to frame trade-offs in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
  • Exceptional communication: you influence without authority and build trust with stakeholders from the warehouse floor to the executive team.
  • Strong writing skills to communicate vision, roadmap, requirements, launches, and impact to a broad audience.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with commercial WMS platforms or building a WMS in-house.
  • Familiarity with warehouse automation, scanning and mobile workflows, or WCS/WES integrations.
  • Exposure to inventory management, EDI, or B2B and DTC fulfillment models.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI or large language model (LLM) technologies to operational workflows.
  • A passion for simplifying and accelerating global trade.

Location and Team

This role is based in Bellevue, WA, on Flexport's Omnichannel Fulfillment product team.

Join Flexport's Omnichannel team and help build the warehouse technology that moves goods around the globe.
