title: Director, Ocean Gateway (PRS)
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The Head of Ocean Gateway, PRS is a critical part of Flexport's mission to make global trade easy for everyone a reality. Your direct stakeholders are the partners within your region, account management, ocean carriers, terminals and trucking providers. Your work directly supports Flexport's end customers in achieving their logistics goals. Most importantly, you will play a pivotal role in building the future operational model at Flexport, allowing us to scale effectively and achieve our mission of making global trade easier for everyone.

This position owns the performance and profitability of the PRS gateway and strategically leads your team through the complex world of logistics. Flexport's operating model is technology-led and AI-enabled, and you will lead the gateway team in working that way. You will work cross-functionally to navigate ambiguous challenges and build a world-class operating team. At this stage in Flexport's journey, we are looking for best-in-class leadership that can articulate a clear vision and excite teams to execute it day in and day out.

Tactical Responsibilities:

As Head of Ocean Gateway, PRS, you are an expert in executing the end-to-end movement of shipments within a regional network, including Ocean FCL and LCL for exports and imports.

  • You will own the gateway's P&L mindset: manage customer profitability and cost to serve, and manage AR/AP together with Finance and account management to keep cash flow healthy.
  • You will build the operational performance framework, process and tools to manage our vendor’s performance in the PRS market according to our company's business needs.
  • You are the primary relationship manager for internal and external stakeholders in your gateway, including partners, ocean carriers, trucking providers, account management, Ocean Procurement / Allocation & Yield and Regional Ocean Management.
  • You will negotiate with carriers locally — local deals and space release — within your delegated authority, and drive carrier performance (on-time execution, rolling, space) through scorecards and volume allocation.
  • You will manage vendor cost and performance (BPO, trucking, terminals and other gateway vendors) against SLAs and cost-per-file targets.
  • You will hire, coach and develop a team of (senior) associates and managers responsible for the end-to-end movement of Ocean FCL and LCL shipments within the gateway, and build succession for key roles.
  • You will lead adoption of Flexport technology and AI in daily gateway work and set the expectation that your team scopes problems AI-first.
  • You will design operational processes and infrastructure to ensure Flexport executes quality service delivery on time, efficiently, cost-effectively and, most importantly, creates a world-class customer experience.
  • You will bring ocean commercial sense to the business: recommend supply chain solutions for new clients and opportunities to the account management and demand teams, support RFQs and tenders with feasible, profitable lane offers, and prepare enablement resources for internal teams to sell our ocean product.
  • You will proactively drive operational improvements and quality consistency with assigned partners, leveraging global performance metrics, targets and dashboards.
  • You will guard the "front line" in ensuring the highest standard of Flexport quality: designing the right processes and metrics for shipments to move on time and exceptions to be resolved quickly and appropriately. You will be accountable for meeting internal KPIs and SLAs that demonstrate quality delivery.

Adaptive Responsibilities:

  • You will allow Flexport to decouple scale and headcount: raise SPO and lower cost to serve through process improvement, automation and AI-enabled workflows, working with global management, Product and Ops Tech.
  • You will work with Product and Ops Tech to define requirements, pilot new features and digital agents in your gateway, and feed frontline learnings back into the technology roadmap.
  • You will drive AI culture in your team as a behavior change, not a tooling rollout: set adoption targets, track weekly-active usage and the effect on productivity, and coach managers to redesign workflows around automation.
  • You will use data and dashboards to make decisions — SPO, cost per file, OTE, exception and margin data — and evolve the front line from problem solver to file owner.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Climate
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Why Climate Matters More Than Ever

Supply chain leaders are being asked to cut costs and carbon at the same time. Yet logistics and sustainability teams often work with different data, tools, and priorities. Meanwhile, regulations and industry standards are raising expectations for how companies measure and manage their emissions.

Most climate tools stop at reporting: a dashboard or a year-end PDF, produced long after a shipment has moved. They rarely reach the people deciding how to route goods, when to ship, or how much inventory to hold.

The Climate team at Flexport is building emissions intelligence directly into the platform where supply chain decisions are made. We help customers weigh cost, speed, and emissions together—and turn that understanding into action.

The Opportunity

Flexport already runs the shipments, holds the data, and provides the platform where customers manage their supply chains. That puts us in a strong position to connect climate insights with the operational decisions that drive emissions.

You will be the primary engineer for Climate, working independently of our existing engineering teams and partnering closely with the Climate Manager, your main day-to-day business stakeholder.

Think of it as a small startup within Flexport: direct access to the business, a broad scope, and substantial ownership. Together with the Climate Manager, you will identify the most valuable problems to solve, shape the product direction, and turn ideas into reliable software. This role calls for someone who enjoys both deciding what to build and building it.

Things We ❤️

  • Turning complex shipment and emissions data into clear, actionable choices.
  • Working directly with stakeholders and users to understand what would make their lives better.
  • Building simple, reliable products and learning from how people use them.
  • Finding opportunities where lower costs and lower emissions go together.
  • Taking an idea from an ambiguous problem to a useful product in production.

You Will

  • Work closely with Climate Programs Manager to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions, and translate business goals into a practical product roadmap.
  • Own delivery from problem discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, operation, and iteration.
  • Build emissions intelligence into everyday supply chain decisions, including routing, transport mode, shipment timing, and inventory planning.
  • Help customers identify opportunities to reduce emissions using Flexport’s shipment data.
  • Make lower-emission choices easier to understand and act on within existing workflows.
  • Develop products that help customers understand the wider environmental footprint of their supply chains, beyond freight.
  • Deliver useful improvements incrementally, balancing speed, scope, maintainability, and data accuracy.
  • Coordinate with other engineering teams when your work depends on shared systems, integrations, or expertise.
  • Measure whether what you ship solves the underlying problem, and use that evidence to decide what comes next.

You Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong engineering foundation and experience delivering production software.
  • A track record of working independently: you can bring structure to an unclear problem, set priorities, unblock yourself, and follow through without a detailed specification or constant direction.
  • Strong product judgment: you understand user needs, identify what is worth building, and make thoughtful tradeoffs between impact and effort.
  • Experience working closely with business stakeholders: you ask good questions, explain technical choices in plain language, and constructively challenge ideas when needed.
  • The ability to own features across the stack, including user interfaces, backend services, and data integrations.
  • A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.
  • Comfort taking responsibility for the reliability and maintenance of what you build.
  • A bias for action, combined with the judgment to recognize when you need input or help.
  • An aptitude for learning quickly, including unfamiliar business domains and technologies.

Nice to Have

  • A personal motivation to work on climate and environmental challenges.
  • Experience in climate technology, emissions accounting, logistics, or supply chain software.
  • Experience building products in a startup or another small team with broad ownership.
  • Experience turning complex data into customer-facing insights and decision tools.

Prior climate experience is a plus; curiosity and the ability to learn the domain matter more.

How We Work

  • Your day-to-day work will center on a close partnership with the Climate Manager, with collaboration across engineering as needed.
  • You will have substantial autonomy and will be expected to keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, progress, and tradeoffs.
  • We build and launch incrementally, using feedback to guide the next step.
  • In Amsterdam, we come to the office two to three times a week to collaborate, whiteboard, and spend time together.
  • Flexport’s broader technology stack includes React, TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, Kotlin, Kubernetes, GraphQL, gRPC, Postgres, Kafka, and Snowflake. We welcome candidates from different technology backgrounds.

What’s in It for You?

  • Direct ownership of products that help customers make better supply chain and environmental decisions.
  • The opportunity to shape Climate technology with the autonomy of a small startup and the reach of Flexport.
  • Equity participation and a defined pension contribution scheme.
  • 25 vacation days based on full-time employment.
  • Fully paid premiums for Flexport’s collective health insurance plan.
  • Catered lunches, breakfast, snacks, and drinks in the office.
  • Covered home-to-office commuting costs for employees living outside Amsterdam.
  • Employee assistance and parental leave benefits.

Account Executive, Flexport Capital

Flexport helps more than 10,000 clients and suppliers lead all aspects of their supply chain operations. Each of these customers faces significant working capital burdens that hamper their ability to grow their businesses. Since inception, Flexport Capital has provided over $2 billion in loans to Flexport customers to address these needs. Our non-dilutive capital products empower businesses to grow and bridge their working capital needs while maintaining ownership and control. As a start-up within a start-up, we’re developing unique fintech products that leverage the resources and data of Flexport’s platform for global trade. We are seeking an entrepreneurial and financially savvy individual to join our tight-knit team.

The Opportunity: Flexport Capital is Flexport’s financing arm, offering inventory and logistics financing, asset-based lending, term loans, and working capital products to Flexport clients. As an Account Executive, you will own the full end-to-end sales cycle for Flexport Capital, from sourcing, prospecting, negotiation, underwriting coordination, and close. You will build and manage your own growing book of business. You will serve as the primary commercial voice for your customers, acting as a financial consultant and strategic advisor to founders, CFOs, and finance teams seeking working capital solutions. You will work directly with Credit, Product, and Legal as a peer partner, shaping product development and go-to-market strategy based on real market feedback. You’ll play a critical role in scaling Flexport Capital’s market presence and establishing it as the go-to financing partner for growth stage businesses. You’ll own building the sales playbook that drives this growth, with full autonomy over your territory and clear upside as you scale.

You Will:

  • Own the full end-to-end sales cycle for your territory, from sourcing and prospecting through deal structuring, underwriting coordination, closing, and early relationship management.
  • Build and own a growing book of business with direct revenue accountability. You'll win new customers, expand relationships as they scale, and identify cross-sell opportunities within your territory.
  • Serve as the commercial relationship owner for your clients. You'll negotiate terms, structure deals, and coordinate with Credit through underwriting to close.
  • Use Flexport's supply chain data as a commercial advantage. By analyzing shipment patterns, volume spikes, transit times, and invoice data, you can identify when customers need capital and turn those signals into targeted actions to drive sustainable growth.
  • Drive strategic initiatives related to growth strategy, sales motions, and capital markets partnerships that expand Flexport Capital's market position.
  • Leverage Flexport's freight and omni capabilities to create working capital solutions that deepen customer relationships, increase wallet share, and win deals competitors can't.

You Should Have:

  • Experience - 6+ years of experience in sales/sales development for a financial services and/or a technology company. Previous startup experience is a plus.
  • Financial & Credit Acumen - Fluency in working capital structures, financial statement analysis, and lending mechanics. You can read and interpret P&Ls, balance sheets, and cash flow statements to assess customer needs. You'll be expected to recommend appropriate lending structures and create tailored working capital solutions for each prospect based on their business model and financing needs.
  • Full-cycle sales execution - You’ve owned deals from prospect through close. You understand pipeline management, deal structuring, and how to navigate complex sales cycles. You’ve hit and exceeded quota consistently.
  • Communication & Presence - Excellent communication and executive presence. You can build trusted relationships with Founders, CEOs, CFOs, and Finance Directors. You navigate senior-level conversations with ease and represent your company credibly with C-suite buyers.
  • Commercial drive and ownership - You’re motivated by building and growing a business. You think like an owner, take accountability for outcomes, and proactively solve problems to move deals forward.
  • Strategic business sense - You see beyond individual deals. You understand market trends, competitive threats, and identify customer needs that create product/GTM opportunities.
  • Data & Tools - Proficiency in Salesforce, Excel, Claude, and other data tools. Ability to design dashboards and reporting frameworks to track pipeline growth and buying signals.

Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Build the operational and technical skill set that runs global trade

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. We're shaping the future of a $10T industry with technology and people who understand it end to end. The Rotational Development Program (RDP) exists because that combination — real supply chain fluency plus the ability to build and automate — doesn't exist at scale in the market today. So we're building it ourselves.

This is an 18-month program, not a rotation for rotation's sake. Every assignment is live, revenue-generating work. Every participant leaves with a certification in AI and low-code tooling running alongside their operational and commercial training. And every graduate places into a role with real scope: primarily Account Management, with paths into Automation Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering/Consulting, Sales Engineering, or a traditional Ops/Sales/Customs track.

What you'll do

You'll rotate through three functions, six months each, with AI/low-code curriculum running continuously across all three:

  • Gateway Ops (Air or Ocean). Own the shipment lifecycle. Execute bookings, manage exceptions, and hold data integrity to Flexport's standard. Build your first automation and reporting skills through structured coursework running in parallel.
  • Customs. Become a global trade expert by navigating the complex world of customs regulations to ensure goods comply with international laws. Simultaneously, move into applied technical work: SQL, workflow automation, Lean process improvement, etc.
  • Sales / Account Management. Take on go-to-market work and build client-facing skills, operating with more independence. Your capstone: identify a real business problem in the function you're sitting in and build the tooling or process fix that solves it. You'll present it to leadership at graduation.

Throughout the program, you'll get:

  • A day-to-day manager in your current rotation and a Rotation Program Manager tracking your development, with mid-point and end-of-rotation evaluations at every stage.
  • Certifications in AI/low-code tooling, from foundational bootcamp through applied builds to a capstone project.
  • Bi-weekly cohort touchpoints and a standing alumni mentor community.
  • Increased earning potential as you clear program benchmarks

This role is for you if you

  • Are on track to graduate, or recently graduated, and want to build a career at the intersection of supply chain operations and technology — not just run one or the other.
  • Are genuinely curious about AI and low-code tooling and want to build real fluency, not just check a resume box.
  • Can operate with minimal supervision, prioritize a high volume of work, and communicate clearly under pressure.
  • Want real ownership fast? This program hands you live client and business work from the very beginning — it is not a shadowing or classroom based program.
  • Have a "compliance-first" mindset. We operate in a heavily regulated industry, and that matters in every rotation.

Ready to build the future of global trade — and the skill set to run it?

Apply now.

title: Staff Security Engineer, Product Security
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

What You'll Do

  • Architecture & strategy
    • Define security architecture for Flexport's products and services, and set the patterns and reference implementations that make secure-by-default the path of least resistance.
    • Lead security engineering reviews for the highest-risk product features, and set the bar for what "good" looks like in reviews you don't personally run.
    • Build and scale the security champions program and product security training that extend your judgment into teams where you can't be in every review.
  • Design-time & review
    • Lead domain-specific threat modeling and attack surface analysis across Flexport's product surface, not just individual features.
    • Partner with engineering leadership to resolve the design tradeoffs that a senior engineer would escalate.
  • Vulnerability management
    • Set the bar for how the team triages, reproduces, and prioritizes bug bounty submissions and internal security reports, and step in on the hardest or highest-severity cases.
    • Drive remediation of systemic classes of vulnerability, not just individual findings.
  • Developer enablement & leadership
    • Own the security services and tooling consumed by product teams across our global infrastructure.
    • Mentor other engineers on the team, and act as the authoritative technical voice on product security across engineering leadership.

You Should Have

  • Typically 8+ years of experience in product/application security, with real hands-on time building security tools and services, not just reviewing them — we care more about what you've built than the exact number.
  • A track record of designing security architecture that scales across many teams and services, not just securing a single product.
  • Strong grasp of web application security principles and hands-on experience with application testing tools (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, or similar)
  • Software development experience building security tools in at least one modern language (Go, Python, Java/Kotlin, TypeScript, Ruby, or similar)
  • Track record of leading multi-team technical initiatives and mentoring engineers into senior roles

Nice to Have

  • Experience running or scaling a security champions program
  • Identity management and identity federation experience (SAML, OAuth, SCIM)
  • Experience with IaaS cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, containers, and service-oriented architectures
  • Hands-on experience with bug bounty platforms and SAST tools (Cycode, Semgrep, Snyk, or similar)
  • Experience performing code audits on internal or open-source libraries before they ship in production

How We Work

  • We're in the San Francisco office regularly to whiteboard and ship together
  • We stay closely aligned with teammates on other continents via Slack, video, and async docs
  • We have the latest hardware and software, including frontier AI models on day one
  • We're agile, but not dogmatic — the team decides how it works best

Why This Role Is Special

  • Massive leverage: the conventions and champions program you build are multiplied across hundreds of engineers who never talk to you directly.
  • Broad authority: you set the architecture other reviews are measured against, rather than being the one measured.
  • You're part of PSI: the platform, security, and infrastructure teams work hand in hand, and security is treated as infrastructure with real engineering quality bars, not a policy function.

Where you'll work

This role is based in San Francisco, and we have a strong preference for candidates who are there or willing to relocate — we're deliberately building this team in one place. Relocation support is available for the right candidate.

Investing your time with Flexport means having immediate impact, all over the world. You're empowered to do what's best for everyone and trusted to make the right decisions when and where you need them. Join our collective of entrepreneurs and improve the world's experience in global trade.

The opportunity:

The role of the Operations Associate is a critical part of making Flexport’s mission to make global trade easy for everyone a reality. Flexport today connects almost 10,000 clients and suppliers across 109 countries. In this role, your direct customers are the partners within your region: our account management and customs teams, subcontractors, carriers, terminals and trucking providers. Your work directly supports Flexport’s end customers in achieving their logistics goals. Most importantly, you will play a pivotal role in building the next operational model at Flexport: allowing us to effectively scale to achieve our mission of making global trade easier for everyone.

This role is designed to facilitate the movement of shipments while discovering and driving efficiencies that build and improve operations as part of our Global team. You will be responsible for ensuring that all customer shipments are executed according to plan, on time and within budget. As the person who manages movement in your region with laser focus, you have the unique opportunity to help your regional account team spot opportunities to improve and grow our customers’ business. You will drive impact through surfacing new ideas to eliminate waste, improve customer experience or introducing innovative ways of managing a supply chain.

You will: 

  • Be the 'front line' in ensuring the highest standard of Flexport quality: shipments move on-time, exceptions are handled proactively, and clients receive a first-class experience through timely, clear communication.
  • Be responsible for ensuring your work satisfies internal KPIs and SLAs that demonstrate quality delivery, independently managing your priorities and commitments.
  • Follow standard operating procedures (SOP) and proactively flag opportunities for improvement.
  • Solve client issues quickly and ensure smooth operations at origin and destination, developing solutions independently and escalating to senior team members as needed
  • Act in the best interest of the company by avoiding leakages and ensuring cost conscious behavior. 
  • Seamlessly coordinate day-to-day operations with the relevant internal and external partners for your team's scope (e.g. carriers, vendors, customs, regional trade lane management, cross-functional stakeholders, etc)
  • Execute the end-to-end movement of freight shipments within a regional network (both imports and exports), including intermodal movements.
  • Assist the shipments managed by partners as we drive partner autonomy and parity with insourced operations (if applicable in a given region).
  • Use data and operational tools to inform decisions, identify patterns in your work, and contribute to efficiency improvements.

Requirements:

  • BA/BS Degree or completed professional training as forwarding agent.
  • 2+ years of experience in operations, logistics or freight forwarding
  • Have a technology (and AI) first mindset and can thrive in a fast paced environment.
  • Effective time management. Be able to properly prioritize and manage a large volume of tasks.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Ability to effectively seek and receive feedback.
  • Effective communication both verbally and in writing.
  • Teamwork and relationship building.
  • Orientation towards working smarter and adopting best practices and standardization.
  • Problem-solving capabilities.
  • A “compliance first” attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.
  • A client service mindset; you are obsessed with client satisfaction, and strive to investigate and troubleshoot the client’s problem.
  • Language requirement: Mandatory Dutch and fluency in English.

What's in there for you: 

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment 
  • Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis 
  • Commute expenses: Flexport will cover  home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam
  • Amazing office in the heart of Amsterdam. 
  • 25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.
  • Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport. 
  • A defined pension contribution scheme
  • Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.
  • Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members
  • Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.

descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Program Manager for Customer Support Strategy, based on-site at our DFW1 facility in Lewisville, TX. Your focus is reducing ticket volume, claims, and contra revenue, and improving the merchant experience. You will do this by improving support processes, ops processes, and engineering, by gathering merchant feedback (starting with NPS) and working cross-functionally to turn it into changes merchants feel, and by keeping content current and owning merchant communications. AI strategy and Zendesk optimization are key levers along the way.

Key Responsibilities

Program Ownership and Strategy:

    • Own omnichannel customer support programs from inception to execution, aligned to business goals and merchant needs.
    • Develop strategies with cross-functional teams, incorporating stakeholder feedback and industry best practices.
    • Drive implementation, overseeing timelines, resources, and budgets.

Ticket Reduction:

    • Analyze ticket data to find the top contact drivers, size them by volume, handle time, and cost, and build a prioritized reduction roadmap with clear targets.
    • Support processes: redesign workflows, macros, routing, and agent guidance so issues are resolved faster with fewer repeat contacts.
    • Ops processes: work with operations and site teams to fix the upstream breakdowns that create tickets, such as inbound, inventory, order, and billing issues.
    • Engineering: partner with engineering and product to prioritize and track the fixes and self-serve tools that remove root causes.

Merchant Experience and Feedback:

    • Own the feedback program, starting with NPS and adding other channels such as post-ticket surveys, agent and account manager input, ticket themes, and direct merchant conversations.
    • Analyze feedback themes and share insights with leadership and partners on a regular cadence.
    • Work cross-functionally with product, engineering, and operations to apply feedback to the merchant’s actual experience, track changes to completion, and close the loop with merchants.

Claims and Contra Revenue Management:

    • Own the claims process end to end, including intake, investigation, resolution, and recovery from carriers and vendors where applicable.
    • Manage and improve contra revenue (credits, refunds, reimbursements, and adjustments) by setting policies, approval thresholds, and controls, and partnering with finance on accurate tracking and reporting.
    • Analyze claim and contra revenue drivers, and work with operations and engineering to fix root causes and reduce both over time.

Content and Merchant Communications:

    • Keep all support content current and managed (help center, knowledge base, macros, internal guides, process documentation), with clear owners and review cadences.
    • Own merchant communications, including notices, announcements, policy and process change letters, banners, and templates.

AI Strategy and Implementation:

    • Build and own the roadmap for AI in support, focused on ticket reduction and merchant experience: agent assist, summarization, auto-categorization and routing, self-service and deflection, QA automation, and knowledge content.
    • Evaluate vendors and models, run pilots with clear success criteria, and take proven use cases into production.
    • Set guardrails for accuracy, human escalation, data privacy, and quality review, and lead training and change management for onsite and offshore teams.

Zendesk Management and Optimization:

    • Own Zendesk configuration and governance: forms and fields, triggers, automations, macros, views, SLAs, routing, groups, and roles. Audit regularly and manage a clear change process.
    • Manage integrations and reporting that turn Zendesk data into decisions, and turn agent pain points into workflow improvements.

Performance, Collaboration, and Stakeholders:

    • Establish and track KPIs: ticket volume, tickets per order or merchant, repeat contact rate, handle time, first-contact resolution, CSAT, NPS, claims, contra revenue, and cost per ticket.
    • Work closely with product, engineering, finance, and operations to integrate support initiatives into overall business operations.
    • Give stakeholders at all levels regular updates on status, challenges, and opportunities.
    • Continuously evaluate and refine programs based on feedback, industry trends, evolving merchant needs, and new AI capabilities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, marketing, or related field.
  • 5+ years of program management experience, preferably in customer support or a related role, with a proven record of delivering complex programs from concept to completion with measurable results.
  • Strong understanding of omnichannel customer support principles, strategies, and technologies.
  • Experience analyzing ticket, claims, or contact data to find root causes and reduce volume or cost, working with operations and engineering to fix them.
  • Experience running or using a merchant or customer feedback program such as NPS, and turning insights into cross-functional changes.
  • Strong writing skills, with experience owning customer communications and keeping support content current.
  • Hands-on Zendesk administration experience (triggers, automations, macros, views, SLAs, reporting).
  • Experience evaluating or implementing AI or automation in support, with a practical view of risks and limits.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to collaborate cross-functionally and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Analytical mindset, able to use data to drive decisions and continuous improvement.
  • Strong project management skills: prioritizing, managing timelines, and allocating resources.
  • Experience in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, adapting to changing priorities. A resilient, focused problem solver and self-starter who can multitask and prioritize in a complex and occasionally ambiguous environment.

Physical requirements:

    • Must be able to lift up to 49 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.
    • Must be willing and able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach.
    • Must be able to stand/walk for up to 10-12 hours.
    • Must be able to work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud.
    • Must be able to work in an environment where the temperature may vary between 60 and 90 degrees and will occasionally exceed 90 degrees.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with SQL (Snowflake a plus), creating and running reports, or Zendesk Explore.
  • Experience writing and testing prompts, or building knowledge content that AI tools draw on.

title: Account Executive I (Farmer)
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The opportunity:

The Sales team at Flexport is dedicated to fostering strong, lasting relationships with our existing clients, ensuring their success and maximizing the value they derive from our platform. As an Account Executive I (Farmer), you play a critical role in driving client success at Flexport — deepening your expertise on our platform, our clients, and the fundamentals of global trade. You will manage a portfolio of accounts where you develop the core skills every great Account Executive I (Farmer) needs: building relationships, running business reviews, and spotting early growth signals. You'll work with clear playbooks and close support from senior teammates as you build the instincts and product knowledge to grow into even more complex client work. 

You will:

- Manage a portfolio of Flexport clients, developing trusted relationships and driving strong satisfaction and retention through consistent, proactive engagement.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day client communications, running regular business reviews (QBRs/MBRs) with support from structured templates and senior teammates.

- Identify and surface early cross-sell and upsell opportunities within your accounts, partnering with senior Account Executives I (Farmer) and Sales to pursue them.

- Collaborate with internal teams (Operations, Product, Implementation) to resolve client issues and deliver consistent service quality.

- Review client performance data to identify trends and potential risks, bringing data-informed insights to your regular client conversations.

- Build foundational knowledge of Flexport's product suite and global trade operations to credibly advise clients on core logistics challenges.

- Work closely with Hunters from the beginning of the customer journey to ensure a seamless transition and long-term client success.

You should have:

- 1+ years of experience in account management, direct sales, client success, operations, or a similar client-facing role; logistics, supply chain, or SaaS background a plus.

- A demonstrated ability to build rapport and trust with clients, with a track record of strong satisfaction or relationship outcomes.

- Strong communication and listening skills, you ask good questions and follow through on commitments.

- Curiosity about how accounts grow and what drives client value; you're developing commercial instincts, not just executing tasks.

- Comfort working within defined processes and seeking guidance when situations are new or ambiguous.

- A 'compliance first' attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.

You will get:

- Structured onboarding and mentorship from experienced Account Executives who invest in your development.

- A clear growth path: Account Executive I (Farmer) is just the start of a career track with increasing scope, complexity, and earning potential.

- Hands-on experience with a global platform moving $19B+ of merchandise across 112 countries.

- A collaborative team environment where asking questions and learning from mistakes is encouraged.

descriptionHtml:
About Flexport:

We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Exciting Trade Advisory Opportunity to Help Make Global Trade Easy

The Opportunity:

The global supply chain is one of the most heavily regulated industries for all parties involved.  Everyone from the carriers, intermediaries, trucking companies, 3rd party logistics, freight forwarders, shippers, consignees, importers, exporters, and brokers face a challenging and complex task of navigating through a myriad of laws from the originating country, destination country as well as international treaties and conventions. 

The Trade Advisory team, consisting of business consultants, lawyers and licensed customs brokers, offers advanced customs and trade expertise to help clients identify supply chain risks and cost savings opportunities. We are looking for a Trade Advisory Associate - Entry Audit to join our Trade Advisory team. This team member will work closely with the Trade Advisory Lead to execute client entry audit projects, managing the day-to-day work associated with each engagement from data intake through final reporting and recommendations.

Audit scope: Entry audits review a client's historical import entries to validate compliance and uncover risk and savings opportunities. Scope typically includes tariff classification, customs valuation, country of origin, duty rates and special program eligibility (including free trade agreements and additional tariff programs), antidumping and countervailing duty exposure, and the accuracy of entry data filed in ACE. Findings are quantified, documented, and translated into corrective actions such as prior disclosures, post summary corrections, and duty refund or recovery opportunities.

You Will:

  • Work closely with the Trade Advisory Lead to scope, plan, and execute client entry audit projects.
  • Manage the day-to-day activities of multiple audit projects, including data requests, timelines, status updates, and deliverables.
  • Pull, clean, and analyze large volumes of entry-level data from sources such as ACE, client database, entry packets (7501, commercial invoice, packing list, etc.)
  • Build and maintain Excel models and workbooks to map data from ACE to client specific business rules.
  • Design, build, and maintain automated workflows and data pipelines using N8N, Parabola, or equivalent tools to streamline audit analysis and reporting.
  • Identify discrepancies, quantify duty and fee impact, and document audit findings with supporting evidence.
  • Prepare clear audit reports and client-ready summaries of findings, root causes, and recommended corrective actions.
  • Support remediation efforts resulting from audit findings, such as post summary corrections, prior disclosures, and refund or recovery filings.
  • Maintain internal audit trackers, workpapers, and documentation to ensure projects are organized, consistent, and auditable.
  • Proactively stay informed on the latest customs and other government agency regulations, ruling issuances, and industry trends that are relevant to our clients.
  • Ensure project timelines, statuses, and invoices are appropriately managed and delivered.
  • Identify opportunities to improve audit SOPs, templates, and automation to increase accuracy and efficiency.
  • Maintain active communication with clients, customs and other government authorities, and internal stakeholders, elevating issues where necessary.
  • Support Trade Advisory infrastructure and administrative requirements.

You should have:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college/university.
  • Licensed Customs Broker (LCB) preferred.
  • 2-4 years experience working in house, at a customs brokerage, importer, trade industry, preferred.
  • Strong data analytical skills, with the ability to analyze large data sets and draw accurate conclusions.
  • Extensive experience with Excel, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, lookups, and large data set analysis.
  • Experience with workflow automation and data tools such as N8N, python, or equivalent.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a high standard of accuracy.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to stay on top of multiple tasks and projects.
  • Strong technical and business writing skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively with a team and with clients.
  • Expertise with Microsoft Office suite and Google equivalents.
  • Working knowledge of classification, valuation, country of origin, duty programs, and government regulations and rulings, preferred.
